tokyo_kacchan_tempura_ueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura stand (wheat batter); the alternative set is oden.
tokyo_kacchan_tempura_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the tempura set includes shrimp and the tempura is served with tentsuyu; the other set is oden.
tokyo_kacchan_tempura_ueno.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:45 (last order 21:30); open all year (Tabelog). No reservations; phone may not be answered while open. Standing only, about 20 places. Non-smoking; smoking outside only. Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). 60-minute limit on the senbero set (April and October 2026 reviews). Opened 31 March 2010 (Tabelog).
tokyo_kacchan_tempura_ueno.notes: [Standing tempura bar · Ueno, the dice senbero under the tracks] A busy stand-up bar under the railway between Ueno and Okachimachi, at the Ameyoko entrance, open from 11 am. Hand over ¥1,300 and you get four dice in a wooden masu: spend them on up to four drinks (a sour is one die, a beer two) and receive a plate of freshly fried tempura — shrimp, eggplant, lotus root, pumpkin and more — or an oden set instead. Extras like conger-eel tempura cost more. Diners in October 2026 loved the crisp tempura, the friendly crowd and the value, but note the drinks are on the light side and there is a 60-minute limit when it's busy; one reviewer paid ¥1,400. Standing only, cash only.

chef_bio.background: A corporate-member Tabelog listing; no source names the operator, owner or cook.
chef_bio.specialty: Senbero set of tempura and four drinks.

anecdotes.text: "When you hand over JPY 1,300, you receive four dice, and you can order your favorite drinks based on the dice rolls… All the drinks are a bit on the lighter side." — October 2026.
"The tempura included shrimp, potato, pumpkin, eggplant, and lotus root. The cost performance is excellent, and the tempura is freshly fried, crispy, and delicious!" — October 2026.
"Although the 60-minute time limit felt a bit rushed, I managed to finish all my drinks within the time." — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): かっちゃん、上野6-12-13、JR上野駅不忍口から徒歩2分、上野と御徒町の間の高架下、上野駅から6軒目 (UNIQLO 側)、毎日11:00〜21:45 (L.O.21:30)、年中無休、予約不可、立ち飲み約20人、禁煙 (外で喫煙)、現金のみ、2010年3月31日オープン。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 1,300円のせんべろでサイコロ4つ、サワーは1つ、ビールは2つ、揚げたての天ぷらの盛り合わせ (海老、じゃがいも、かぼちゃ、なす、れんこん、にんじん) かおでんのセット、60分制、1,400円だったという声、穴子の天ぷら、ひと口カレー、日替わりはおでんの盛り合わせ、ハイボール、ISAINA のソーダ割り、シークワーサーサワー、ポン酢サワー、日本酒 Mio、飲み物は薄め、店員と隣の客がにぎやかで親切。

cultural_comfort.note: Dice system for drinks; other customers and staff explain it (October 2026).

existence.note: Corporate-member Tabelog listing; reviews dated October 2026.

tokyo_katsuretsu_takeda_yotsuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a cutlet house where nearly every main is breaded and fried (pork, chicken and tenderloin cutlets, croquettes, fries), with demi-glace and curry sauces. The butter-grilled scallops or oysters and pork ginger are not breaded, but the sauces are not described.
tokyo_katsuretsu_takeda_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every set is built on pork, beef, chicken or seafood; rice, shredded cabbage and pickles are the only plant items.
tokyo_katsuretsu_takeda_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Sat 11:00–15:30 (last order 15:00); closed Sunday, holidays, Obon and New Year (Tabelog). No reservations; expect a line: 20–40 minutes is common, a Saturday diner waited 2 hours in March 2026, and in October 2026 one diner was 12th in line at 10:50 and still got in at opening. Cash or PayPay only, PayPay since the end of 2025 (Tabelog; January 2026 review). Order by voice, pay after (October 2026). 13 seats: two counters and two tables for two; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 26 September 2011 per Tabelog; TV Tokyo says the shop reopened as Takeda two days after Elise closed, giving Elise's run as 1970–2009.
tokyo_katsuretsu_takeda_yotsuya.notes: [Yoshoku · Yotsuya, a cutlet diner with a line at the station crossing] A 13-seat Showa-style Western diner at the Yotsuya-mitsuke crossing, on Tabelog's Diner or Teishoku 100 list in 2021, 2024 and 2026, and almost always with a line outside. TV Tokyo tells its story: from 1970 the spot was Elise, a yoshoku restaurant loved by 上智大学 students, which closed one day without warning and reopened two days later as Takeda, keeping Elise favourites such as the winter butter-grilled oyster set; a Tabelog user's roundup says Elise was opened by the second generation of a business founded in Tsukiji and that the third generation turned it into this cutlet shop. The house cutlet is a thick aged Mochibuta loin under demi-glace and grated Edam; crab cream croquettes are the add-on reviewers mention most, and autumn brings butter-grilled scallops before the oysters. In October 2026 the Elise beef tomato returned for a limited time. Three cooks behind the counter, signatures of TV crews and celebrities on the walls. Cash or PayPay; no bookings; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.origin: TV Tokyo (アド街ック天国, 14 November 2020): the shop was the yoshoku restaurant エリーゼ from 1970 to 2009, closed without notice and reopened two days later as たけだ. Tabelog gives the opening date as 26 September 2011.
chef_bio.background: No source names the owner or cooks. A Tabelog user's roundup (matome 27344) about 洋食エリーゼ えいすけ in Mizuho-dai says the business was founded in Tsukiji, the second generation opened 洋食エリーゼ in Yotsuya, the third generation converted it into this katsuretsu shop, and a cook who trained alongside the third generation, 佐藤氏, opened えいすけ. An October 2026 diner notes that えいすけ's menu calls the beef tomato the most popular dish at "Yotsuya Elise". An October 2026 diner counted three staff in the kitchen and saw TV and celebrity signatures on the walls. Tabelog Diner "Tabelog 100" 2024 and 2026; Teishoku "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork katsuretsu with demi-glace and Edam; crab cream croquette; winter butter-grilled oysters.

anecdotes.text: "Once again, I had to wait 2 hours… I guess it's to be expected on a Saturday… it's a monthly treat for me, so I don't mind waiting." — March 2026, a 14th visit.
"This time, I decided to try the Beef Tomato, a revival dish from the Elise era. - Beef Tomato Set Meal (JPY 1500)" — October 2026.
"The interior has a retro Western-style diner vibe reminiscent of the Showa era… The walls are adorned with signatures from TV shows and various celebrities." — October 2026, pork ginger set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: テレビ東京「出没！アド街ック天国」(2020年11月14日、四谷): かつれつ 四谷たけだ、揚げ物メニューがメイン、1970年から2009年までは「エリーゼ」という人気の洋食屋、上智大生に愛された「エリーゼ」は予告なく閉店し、2日後に「たけだ」として再オープン、冬季限定の「カキバター焼定食」などエリーゼ時代の人気メニューの一部は今も健在、四谷1-4-2 峯村ビル1F。食べログまとめ (ユーザー): えいすけはもともと築地で創業、二代目が四ツ谷に「洋食エリーゼ」を開業、三代目がカツレツ専門店「かつれつ四谷たけだ」に業態転換、三代目と修行をともにした佐藤氏が「えいすけ」を開業。食べログ (店舗会員): 食堂百名店2024・2026、定食百名店2021、月〜金11:00〜15:30・17:00〜21:00、土11:00〜15:30、日祝休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、13席、禁煙、2011年9月26日オープン、ポークかつれつ定食1,680円 (デミグラスとエダムチーズ)、カニクリームコロッケ定食1,300円。口コミ(2026年1月〜10月): 行列、ビーフトマト定食、カニクリームコロッケ1個480円、ホタテバター焼定食1,800円、カキは11月から、厨房に3人、壁にサイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Join the line, order by voice when seated (October 2026); cash or PayPay.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing, menu updated May 2026, Tabelog 100 2026; reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_spaghetti_nagai_yotsuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a spaghetti shop; every main is wheat pasta, and several sauces are soy-sauce based.
tokyo_spaghetti_nagai_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. Most spaghetti carries cod roe, seafood, bacon, sausage, tuna, egg or cream; a garlic sauce with basil exists, but the one reviewed came with clams. The mini salad is the plant dish named.
tokyo_spaghetti_nagai_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–20:00, no afternoon break; may close early some days; closed Sunday, with occasional Sunday openings (Tabelog). No reservations; a line at lunch (30–40 minutes once in September 2026), quiet mid-afternoon (2025–26 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog). 16 seats: an L-shaped counter of 6 and tables (2×4, 1×2); up stairs on the 2nd floor, with no sign outside (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Non-smoking (Tabelog).
tokyo_spaghetti_nagai_yotsuya.notes: [Pasta · Yotsuya, a one-cook spaghetti counter up the stairs] No sign outside: climb to the second floor of an old building on Shinmichi-dōri and you find an L-shaped counter, a few tables and walls of bookshelves, with Western rock playing softly. Diners place it in the Hashiya line of Japanese-style spaghetti: thick-ish noodles served piping hot, cod roe with squid and shiso, a soy-sauce egg and bacon "carbonara" one diner likened to tamago kake gohan, seafood in a tomato sauce that is not sweet, and meat sauce with tuna. A diner on a sixth visit in September 2026 says the cook works alone yet keeps waits short; one diner called the owner a book-loving craftsman, and an October 2026 diner came for the carbonara that, in the diner's words, Gentosha's Kenjo loves. The woman out front struck two 2026 diners as curt, and one found the pasta ordinary. Open straight through from 11:30 to 20:00, so mid-afternoon has no line; cash only; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: No source names the owner (one September 2026 diner wrote "Mr. Nagai?" as a guess). "Although the chef operates solo, [the chef] works efficiently, ensuring minimal wait times" (September 2026); "The owner was a book-loving, craftsman-like gentleman" (September 2026); "The owner… seems to be in charge of the kitchen, while a woman… manages the dining area" (September 2026). Reviews place the shop in the "Hashiya" lineage of Japanese-style spaghetti (September 2026, two reviewers).
chef_bio.specialty: Cod roe and squid; egg and bacon in soy sauce; seafood tomato.

anecdotes.text: "It is well-known as a prestigious establishment that follows the famous 'Hashiya' lineage of spaghetti… Although the chef operates solo, [the chef] works efficiently, ensuring minimal wait times." — September 2026, a sixth visit.
"Today, I stopped by 'Nagai' to enjoy the carbonara that Gentosha's Kenjo loves." — October 2026, egg and bacon ¥1,300.
"To explain it simply, it's like a pasta version of TKG (Tamago Kake Gohan). You have egg, a hint of soy sauce, and the carbohydrates from the pasta." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スパゲティながい、パスタ、四谷1-8 中川ビル2F、南北線四ツ谷駅から徒歩2分、JR・丸ノ内線3分、月〜土・祝11:30〜20:00、早く閉める日も、日曜休み (臨時営業あり)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、禁煙。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年10月): Hashiya の系譜、看板なしの2階、たらこといか (大葉)、たらことうに、エッグベーコン (醤油味)、海の幸のトマトソース、ミートソースとツナ、あさりとバジルのガーリック、1,300〜1,500円、大盛り、ミニサラダ300円、料理人はひとり、本棚、通し営業、昼は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or table from the menu; cash only.

tokyo_kakurega_dining_saate_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. Steak, churrasco and roast meats are the core, but sauces are not described; much else is wheat-based or fried (kara-age, croquettes, garlic toast, pasta, naan, croutons on the Caesar).
tokyo_kakurega_dining_saate_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. The listing ticks "Vegetarian options"; edamame, salads, fresh spring rolls and fries are on the menu, but nothing is marked vegan and the courses centre on meat.
tokyo_kakurega_dining_saate_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sunday only for booked groups of five or more, by phone by the day before (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog). 45 seats, curtained semi-private rooms for 4 to 20, whole-floor hire for 35–50; smoking allowed except at lunch; children not admitted at dinner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). Same-day bookings welcome (June 2026 review).
tokyo_kakurega_dining_saate_yotsuya.notes: [Izakaya · Yotsuya, a meat bar with curtained booths] A second-floor dining bar at the mouth of Shinmichi-dōri, a minute from the station, whose sign in Latin letters confused one returning diner. Curtains split the 45 seats into semi-private booths, and the menu leans Western: sizzling steak on a hot plate, churrasco, house roast beef and roast pork, kara-age, ajillo with bread, garlic toast, fried rice to finish. Most 2026 visitors came for the cheap drinks courses, from about ¥3,000 for two hours with nine dishes up to a three-hour meat course with wagyu steak and all-you-can-eat fried chicken and fries; one Saturday night in August 2026 the place was nearly empty. Open from 11:00 every day but Sunday (groups by booking only); smoking allowed at night, no children at dinner.

chef_bio.background: No source names the owner or cooks. Corporate-member Tabelog listing ("Enjoy plenty of alcohol and Meat Dishes"). An August 2026 review describes the "Hearty Meat Course" from ¥5,980 down to ¥4,980.
chef_bio.specialty: Steak, churrasco and roast beef; drinks courses.

anecdotes.text: "At first, I thought I had entered a different restaurant! The name was written in English or romaji, so I really couldn't tell!" — February 2026, a second visit.
"The most impressive dish was the Wild Plate with three kinds of meat. It features beef churrasco, roast beef, and roast pork, all served together." — August 2026.
"It was a Saturday night, but the restaurant was quite empty, and I was able to walk in without a reservation!" — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 隠れ家ダイニング さーて、居酒屋・バル・ステーキ、四谷1-7-15 山田ビル2F、新道通りの入口、四ツ谷駅から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、日曜は前日までの5名以上の予約のみ、チャージ料なし、45席、カーテンで仕切る半個室、喫煙可 (ランチは禁煙)、ディナーは子ども不可、カード・QR 可、牛ステーキ1,580円、牛シュラスコ1,480円、ローストビーフ1,280円、2時間飲み放題付きコース3,000〜4,500円、3時間のコース5,000円 (割引後)。口コミ(2026年2月〜8月): ステーキ、ローストビーフ、シュラスコ、唐揚げ、アヒージョ、ガーリックトースト、チャーハン、ワイルドプレート、飲み放題のコース、土曜の夜は空いていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu or book a course; set drinks plans.

tokyo_kaiseki_oui_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the official site says "アレルギー等ご相談くださいませ" (consult us about allergies). Courses include sashimi with sweet soy sauce, sukiyaki, battered fried dishes, soba as a finish and chocolate cake (2025–26 reviews).
tokyo_kaiseki_oui_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-led kaiseki; the courses include fish, wagyu and chicken.
tokyo_kaiseki_oui_yotsuya.hours_raw: Tue–Sat lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:30–22:00 (last seating 20:00); Sunday lunch only; closed Monday, holidays and over New Year (Tabelog; official site). Reservations advised (lunch was full twice for one January 2026 diner); same-day cancellations charged in full (Tabelog). Dinner can also be à la carte (April 2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter facing the open kitchen and one semi-private room for up to 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 8 October 2020; the site marked its 6th anniversary on 8 October 2026.
tokyo_kaiseki_oui_yotsuya.notes: [Kaiseki · Yotsuya, a six-seat counter down a lane] Down a narrow lane off Shinjuku-dōri, a quiet Japanese room with six counter seats facing the open kitchen and one small semi-private room, opened in 2020 and run by 宮島央一, an owner-chef who, the site says, drew on time abroad to train in creative kaiseki, sushi and Italian kitchens. Courses change daily: sashimi with a sweet soy sauce, a grilled fish such as Lake Biwa ayu, a fried course, A5 wagyu as sukiyaki or steak, and rice cooked in a clay pot, whose leftovers come back as onigiri to take home; the rich chocolate cake at the end astonished one diner. Lunch from ¥3,000 is the way in and books up, and dinner runs ¥7,950–13,000, or à la carte. One diner says the name comes from Hokusai. Closed Mondays and holidays; Sunday lunch only.

roles: Owner-chef (official site: "店主 宮島央一")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: drawing on experience abroad, trained at shops of many genres, chiefly creative Japanese and kaiseki, sushi and Italian; "色々経験した分、誰にも真似できないと思って" (having experienced so much, no one else can copy it). Tabelog: "our chef, who has experience in both Japanese and Italian cuisine"; an August 2026 diner learned that the chef had worked in Italian cuisine. Opened 8 October 2020 (Tabelog; the site's anniversary notices). The site lists Tabelog and 一休.com bookings and an online store.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients chosen with care and served as courses; inventive dishes from an owner unbound by convention (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; A5 beef sukiyaki; clay-pot takikomi gohan.

anecdotes.text: "The rice was cooked in a clay pot, and even though it was too much for two people to finish, I appreciated that they made it into onigiri for us to take home!" — July 2025, lunch.
"Lunch kaiseki for JPY 3,000, tax included. A cozy restaurant with 6 counter seats and private rooms… The name is indeed derived from Hokusai." — November 2025.
"The sukiyaki had a refined balance, not too sweet… and at JPY 2000, it was an incredible value." — April 2026, à la carte after a walk at Chidorigafuchi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kaisekioui.tokyo): 大人の隠れ家 四ツ谷 会席応為、落ち着いた和空間にカウンター席と半個室、旬な食材を厳選しコース仕立て、店主の枠にとらわれない独創的な逸品、ワインや日本酒、クラフトビール、ランチコース3,000円・5,000円・7,000円、おまかせコース7〜8品7,950円、10品9,980円、最上級コース10品13,000円 (税込)、アレルギー等ご相談くださいませ、店主 宮島央一、海外経験を活かして和食メインの創作・懐石料理、寿司、イタリアンなど様々なジャンルの店で修行、ランチ11:30〜14:00、ディナー17:30〜22:00、定休日は月曜日・祝日、日曜日はランチ営業のみ、2026年10月8日に6周年、四谷1丁目2-6 アーバンビルサカス5 1B。食べログ (店舗会員): 2020年10月8日オープン、10席 (カウンター6、半個室1で4名まで)、A5の牛のすき焼き、当日キャンセルは100%。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): 細い路地、土鍋のごはんの残りはおにぎりに、チョコレートケーキ、カウンターで調理が見える、昼は予約で満席のことも、アラカルトのすき焼き2,000円、松茸の椀、名前は Hokusai にちなむという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses booked online (Tabelog, 一休.com); counter seats face the kitchen.

existence.note: Official site (6th-anniversary notice 8 October 2026) and shop-maintained Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_roppongi_chotto.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free. The long menu includes homemade gyoza, fried fish, sweet-and-spicy konnyaku, butter-and-soy teppan vegetables and soy-grilled rice balls (2024–2025 reviews).
tokyo_roppongi_chotto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-skewer izakaya; vegetable dishes such as the mixed butter teppan use butter and soy, and the appetizer has been oden.
tokyo_roppongi_chotto.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:15–23:30; Sat 18:30–22:30; holidays 18:15–22:30; closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; July 2025). Book ahead — it is often full (June 2024, July 2025). Smoking allowed; no children (Tabelog). 20 seats, counter and tables, up an elevated floor reached by a small path (May 2026).
tokyo_roppongi_chotto.notes: [Izakaya · Roppongi, a couple-run Showa izakaya] Up a narrow way to the second floor of an old building a minute from Roppongi crossing, a 20-seat izakaya that reviewers describe as run by a couple, with a retro Showa feel, a TV in the corner and a menu so long it is hard to choose. The cook — the elderly gentleman in the kitchen, as one January 2026 diner put it — makes almost everything single-handed: sizzling homemade gyoza on a hot plate, fried mehikari, butter-and-soy teppan vegetables, satsuma-age, eel-liver skewers, sashimi and daily specials, most around ¥800. Prices are low for Roppongi (about ¥3,500 a head in October 2025), the shochu is poured strong, and it fills with office workers, so book. Cash only; smoking allowed; no children; closed Sundays.

roles: Couple-run (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the izakaya as run by a couple: "A Showa-era style izakaya run by a couple" and the wife's enthusiastic service (July 2025); "this cozy izakaya run by a couple" (October 2025); "the elderly gentleman in the kitchen" (January 2026); "the chef prepares almost everything by himself" and a chat "with the master and the owner" (May 2026). No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade gyoza; long Showa izakaya menu.

anecdotes.text: "Six large gyoza filled with a generous amount of stuffing! Served sizzling hot on a teppan." — October 2025, homemade gyoza ¥800.
"The coffee liqueur is homemade and usually only served to regular customers... I'm grateful for that." — May 2026.
"The retro Showa-style interior really lifts the spirits. It's like being in a theme park!" — June 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 六本木 ちょっと、港区六本木4-10-8 パーレットビル2F、六本木の交差点から74m、月〜金18:15〜23:30、土18:30〜22:30、祝18:15〜22:30、日曜休み、営業時間は変わることがある、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、20席、喫煙可、子ども不可。口コミ(2024年6月〜2026年5月): 夫婦で営む昭和の居酒屋、メニューが多い、本日のおすすめ、自家製餃子800円、めひかりの唐揚げ800円、ミックスバター800円、焼きおにぎり300円、生ビール小400円、白子ポン酢、さつま揚げ、うなぎの肝串、ピリ辛こんにゃく、常連向けの自家製コーヒーリキュール、予約がおすすめ、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: A long Japanese menu and daily specials; no English menu is listed on Tabelog.

tokyo_kunpu_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free; every course ends with the house fresh-baked bread, and dishes have included chicken tempura, chijimi and a mapo tofu bowl (2025–2026 reviews).
tokyo_kunpu_roppongi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options" and the shop invites you to name what you want to eat, but courses centre on fish, meat and cheese.
tokyo_kunpu_roppongi.hours_raw: From 18:00, usually to about 24:00 (Tabelog says sometimes as late as 05:00; the official site says until 24:00, and earlier starts by arrangement). Closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog); the official site also lists Saturdays as closed, with weekend and holiday hire for 20 or more. December: open every day until the 30th; reopens 3 January (Tabelog). No service charge. 100 seats, all semi-private, divided by roll screens (official site; a June 2026 diner could hear the next table); half the room (30 seats) can be hired for ¥30,000. Non-smoking. Cards and QR. Children welcome, with a kids' menu. Opened 1 September 1999 (Tabelog).
tokyo_kunpu_roppongi.notes: [Izakaya · Roppongi, all-in courses with premium shochu and fresh bread] On the second floor along Roppongi-dori, a 100-seat restaurant of semi-private tables divided by roll screens, open since 1999. Courses include the drinks — and they are serious ones: Juyondai sake, Moriizo, Maou and Murao shochu, Yamazaki and Ichiro's Malt whisky — while beer and highball glasses grow bigger with every refill. The food is "sosaku" (creative) Japanese-Western cooking made fresh, with a Caesar salad tossed at the table under shaved cheese and fresh-baked bread with honey to finish every course; a July 2026 business dinner featured Oita fish and Bungo beef. Diners call the drinks a bargain; one in June 2026 found the food plainer than expected and the screens thin, and one notes the owner's strong personality. Mostly for groups; closed Sundays and holidays (and Saturdays, per the shop's site).

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 1999 (Tabelog). The official site promises nothing frozen or made in advance, premium drinks at nearly cost, and drinks you request a week ahead. A December 2025 reviewer mentions the owner's strong personality; a July 2026 diner notes turmeric drinks and tablets on the table. No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Tell us what you want to eat" — written on the menu since opening (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Premium all-you-can-drink courses; table-side Caesar salad; fresh-baked bread.

anecdotes.text: "To my surprise, they serve the renowned Junmai Daiginjo sake, Juyondai, in generous pours. The all-you-can-drink option at JPY 5,000 raises questions about how they can offer such value." — December 2025.
"The signature dish here is the Caesar salad, prepared right in front of you." — May 2026.
"The seating is separated by a curtain, so I could hear everything from the neighboring table quite clearly." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yasaiya.tokyo/kunpuu): 薫風、六本木の総作料理店、十四代、森伊蔵、山崎、イチローズモルトなどがコースにより飲み放題、総作料理と自家製パンが名物、すべての席が半個室 (ロールスクリーンで仕切る)、六本木駅から272m、コースだとビールやハイボールのグラスがどんどん成長する、プレミアムなお酒がほぼ原価、すべてのコースに焼きたてパン、冷凍や作り置きはしない、お祝いに文字メッセージ料理や塩釜、お肉のケーキ、店の半分30名の貸切は個室料3万円、六本木4-8-3 日栄ビル2F、18:00から24:00まで、土日祝休み (20名以上で貸切可)。食べログ: 日栄ビル2F・3F、大江戸線六本木駅6番出口から徒歩5分、日祝休み、遅いときは朝5時まで、100席、サービス料なし、禁煙、カード・QR可、子ども可、1999年9月1日オープン。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年7月): 十四代、森伊蔵、Maou、Murao、飲み放題5,000円、目の前で和えるシーザーサラダ、焼きたてのパンと蜂蜜、骨付きハンバーグ、Oita の Seki-aji・Seki-saba、Bungo beef のハンバーグ、店主の個性が強いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Course-based; no English menu is listed on Tabelog.

tokyo_yelo_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice with syrups and milk sauces may avoid wheat, but nothing is called gluten-free and toppings such as tiramisu (with cocoa and mascarpone) and the hot dogs are not described.
tokyo_yelo_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the kakigori are built on fresh milk sauces, with mascarpone and cream toppings (official site; 2026 reviews).
tokyo_yelo_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:00–02:00; Fri 11:00–05:00; Sat 11:30–05:00; Sun 11:30–02:00; to 05:00 on weekdays in summer; hours change by season — check the shop's X account (Tabelog; official site). No reservations; a paid TableCheck FastPass for priority entry in summer (official site); long summer queues (2020 review). 16 seats: 6 at the counter and five tables for two. Non-smoking. Cards, IC/e-money and QR. Children welcome. English menu. Self-service water and rooibos tea. Opened 1 April 2014 (Tabelog).
tokyo_yelo_roppongi.notes: [Kakigori · Roppongi, shaved ice until the small hours] A small kakigori bar three minutes from Roppongi Station that serves shaved ice all year and late into the night — to 2 am most days and 5 am at weekends. The ice is pure, temperature-controlled and shaved fine, under house syrups and fresh milk sauces; the tiramisu kakigori with extra mascarpone foam is the favourite (about ¥1,500 in 2026), with pistachio, mango and seasonal flavours, plus "night kakigori" spiked with alcohol such as rum raisin. The same shop runs Amber for hot dogs and hot sandwiches. Reviews in 2026 range from "Japan's best" to "average", and one late-night diner found the second bowl crunchy; summer brings queues (a paid FastPass is offered). Self-service water and rooibos.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2014 (Tabelog). The official site presents yelo (kakigori) with Amber (hot dogs and hot sandwiches), whose sausages come from a workshop keeping to traditional German methods and whose bread was developed with a well-known baker.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Light and healthy, yet as satisfying as any sweet" — pure ice kept at the right temperature for a fine, melting texture, with homemade syrups and fresh milk sauce, to enjoy all year (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tiramisu kakigori; night kakigori.

anecdotes.text: "I've visited over 50 kakigori shops across the country, and this one is truly the best!" — August 2026.
"I visited around 1:30 AM and was surprised to find the place completely empty!… the second order of strawberry was quite crunchy." — September 2026.
"I definitely recommend adding the espuma! For just JPY 200, it’s worth adding to everything." — September 2026, tiramisu ¥1,300 and pistachio ¥1,400.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yelo.jp): かき氷 yelo とホットドッグ・ホットサンドの Amber、良質な純氷の温度管理で細かく心地よい口どけ、自家製シロップとフレッシュなミルクソース、一年中楽しめる、NIGHT KAKIGORI、本場ドイツの伝統製法の老舗工房のソーセージと名店のパン職人と共同開発のセミハードブレッドのホットドッグ、営業時間は時期により変わり公式Xで案内、港区六本木5-2-11 パティオ六本木1F、夏季限定の有料の優先案内 (Table Check FastPass)。食べログ: 月〜木11:00〜翌2:00、金11:00〜翌5:00、土11:30〜翌5:00、日11:30〜翌2:00、夏は平日も朝5時まで、予約不可、16席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、英語メニュー、水とルイボスティーはセルフ、2014年4月1日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ティラミス1,300円とエスプーマ200円、ピスタチオ1,400円、マンゴー、苺、ラムレーズン、深夜でも空いている、日本一という声と普通という声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); order with the staff.

tokyo_go_tsubo_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Raw, steamed and grilled oysters are served simply, but nothing is called gluten-free and side dishes include uni butter toast and a salted-cod-roe baked potato (2026 reviews).
tokyo_go_tsubo_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster bar; side dishes include bacon, mussels, cod roe and sea urchin.
tokyo_go_tsubo_roppongi.hours_raw: From 18:00; closes when the day's oysters run out (July 2026); hours and closing days may change (Tabelog). The closing time here is a placeholder. Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). A one-person operation — book by phone right after opening or later in the evening, say how many oysters you want, and order all at once (September 2026). No glasses for water; buy a bottle from the vending machine downstairs (September 2026). 14 counter seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog).
tokyo_go_tsubo_roppongi.notes: [Oysters · Roppongi, a one-man oyster bar at ¥250 a piece] On the fourth floor of a back-street building, a 14-seat counter with doodles on the walls and a blackboard crammed with dishes, where the owner alone shucks, steams and grills oysters at about ¥250 apiece — Akkeshi oysters in July 2026, and one July 2026 diner ate about 20. Order them raw, steamed (the favourite of several reviewers) or grilled, add uni butter toast or a cod-roe baked potato, and drink wine by the bottle; around ¥6,000 a head with plenty of drinking. It is cash only, there are no water glasses (buy a bottle downstairs), smoking is allowed, and when the oysters run out the night is over — so book by phone, say how many oysters you want, and order everything early. One diner noted the view over a cemetery.

roles: Owner, working alone (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A September 2026 reviewer who first came seven years earlier writes that "the owner manages everything by himself"; another September 2026 diner calls it "a one-person operation". No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Oysters raw, steamed or grilled at about ¥250 each; uni butter toast.

anecdotes.text: "The oysters are only JPY 250 each and incredibly delicious, so it’s easy to overindulge!" — September 2026: 12 raw, 4 grilled and 14 steamed for the table.
"When I asked for a chaser of water, I was told, 'We don’t have glasses, so please buy a bottle from the vending machine downstairs.'" — September 2026.
"Eating oysters while looking at the cemetery was an interesting experience." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 5坪 六本木店、港区六本木3-8-10 じゃるだんビル4F、18:00から、営業時間と定休日は変わることがある、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、14席 (カウンター)、喫煙可。口コミ(2026年3月〜9月): 生、蒸し、焼きの牡蠣が1個約250円 (3月は230円)、Akkeshi の牡蠣、雲丹バタートースト、明太子のじゃがバター、アボカドと明太子、燻製大根とクリームチーズ、長芋キムチ、ムール貝の酒蒸し、厚切りベーコン、店主が一人で切り盛り、牡蠣がなくなったら閉店、予約時に牡蠣の数を、現金のみ、水のグラスはなく下の自販機で、墓地の見える窓。

cultural_comfort.note: Blackboard menu in Japanese; one man runs the shop, so order early and all at once.

tokyo_hi_no_buta_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles in a Jiro-style bowl.
tokyo_hi_no_buta_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tonkotsu broth, pork chashu and a meat mapo sauce on the Fusion.
tokyo_hi_no_buta_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:45); Sun 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:45); hours may change (Tabelog). Buy a ticket and pay by PayPay — no cards or e-money (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 7 counter seats, cramped (September 2026). The shop asks queuers not to block the neighbours' doors or the apartment entrance and to fold back at "Kamiya" (Tabelog). Delivery riders pick up orders (October 2026). Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog).
tokyo_hi_no_buta_ningyocho.notes: [Ramen · Ningyocho, a Jiro-meets-Nakamoto bowl at a 7-seat counter] Ningyocho's only Jiro-style ramen shop (September 2026), seven cramped counter stools a minute from exit A5. The owner trained at both Ramen Jiro and Nakamoto (nlab, 2018; July 2026 review) and fused them in the house "Fusion": a mountain of bean sprouts and thick pork over thick noodles, crowned with spicy mapo tofu. Call garlic, ginger and extra vegetables when asked. The plain ramen (¥950) and dry noodles are there too, plus a rotating limited bowl — chilled noodles in summer, a yakisoba bowl in October 2026. Opinions split. Fans praise the thick tender pork and the mapo, while October 2026 diners found the broth weak and the noodles thinner and drier than they remembered. Two September and October 2026 diners found the service curt. Expect a short queue at lunch; PayPay only. The head shop is in Kuki, Saitama, and this one is directly run.

roles: Owner (unnamed; trained at Ramen Jiro and Nakamoto, per nlab 2018 and a July 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per nlab (ITmedia), 30 March 2018: the head shop is 蒙麺火の豚 in Kuki, Saitama; the Ningyocho shop is directly run, not a franchise; the owner trained at both Jiro and Nakamoto; the "Fusion" is the signature. Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog). An October 2026 diner who had not visited for four years found the niboshi ramen gone and limited bowls rotating.
chef_bio.specialty: The Fusion: Jiro-style ramen with Nakamoto-style mapo.

anecdotes.text: "The 'Fusion' combines Jiro-style with Mongolian flavors, featuring a small amount of tofu on top of bean sprouts, covered in a spicy mapo tofu sauce." — September 2026, ¥1,050.
"However, even after mixing it well, the flavor was weak and lacked richness." — October 2026, ramen ¥950.
"The pork was thick and tender—so tasty!" — July 2026, Fusion ¥1,000, tenth visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: nlab (ITmedia、2018年3月30日): 火の豚の本店は埼玉県久喜市の「蒙麺火の豚」、人形町の店舗はのれん分けではなく直営店、店主は二郎・中本の両方で修行、目玉メニューは「フュージョン」。食べログ: 火の豚 人形町駅前店、ラーメン、人形町3-7-14、人形町駅A5出口から徒歩1分、月〜土11:00〜15:00、17:30〜21:00、日11:00〜15:00、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、7席 (カウンターのみ)、2018年2月26日オープン、並ぶときは両隣の店の前に並ばない。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): 人形町で唯一の二郎系、フュージョン1,000円・汁なし1,050円、ラーメン950円、にんにく、生姜、野菜増しのコール、厚くて柔らかい豚、限定の冷やし中華や焼きそば、味が薄いという声や接客がそっけないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine and Jiro-style topping calls (garlic, vegetables) when the staff ask; cramped counter (2026 reviews).

tokyo_menya_oto_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-made wheat noodles in a soy-sauce and niboshi broth.
tokyo_menya_oto_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dried-sardine (niboshi) broth with pork chashu.
tokyo_menya_oto_ningyocho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:30; closed only over the New Year (Tabelog). Ticket machine; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; August 2026). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Regular, large or extra noodles at no extra charge, and a free topping that changes by weekday (August–October 2026). Opened 15 June 2023 (Tabelog).
tokyo_menya_oto_ningyocho.notes: [Ramen · Ningyocho, niboshi ramen from a Kitasenju favourite] A ten-seat counter two minutes from Ningyocho station, the branch of a popular Kitasenju niboshi shop (Tabelog), open every day from 11:00 to 22:30. Two soups to choose from. The light niboshi soba (¥890) is a clean soy-sauce bowl that one August 2026 diner found barely tasted of sardine. The original rich niboshi ramen (¥990) is cement-grey but, reviewers say, balanced rather than overpowering. Both come with thin, straight house-made noodles that snap when bitten, chashu, menma and yuzu peel. A larger portion or extra noodles cost nothing, and there's a free topping that changes by day. Cash only via a ticket machine. One August 2026 diner was put off by stained paper aprons.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text: the main store in Kitasenju is a popular spot (Tabelog 3.69); soup crafted by skilled artisans over three days; house-made noodles without preservatives; the social-media account is shared across all locations. Opened 15 June 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Light and rich niboshi ramen; house-made noodles.

anecdotes.text: "The broth had the characteristic grayish hue of niboshi (dried sardines), but it wasn't the overly thick and rich type." — October 2026, original rich niboshi ramen ¥990.
"The broth was a light soy sauce flavor, and I didn't really taste the niboshi (dried sardines)." — August 2026, seasoned-egg light niboshi soba ¥990.
"When I requested a paper apron, the first one had stains that looked like soup splatters." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺屋 音 人形町店、ラーメン、つけ麺、日本橋人形町2-6-12、人形町駅A3出口から徒歩2分、毎日11:00〜22:30 (年末年始以外)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、10席、禁煙、子ども可、2023年6月15日オープン、Kitasenju の本店は食べログ3.69、3日かけて作るスープ、無添加の自家製麺、SNSは全店共通。メニュー (2026年9月): 淡麗煮干しそば890円、味玉990円、特製1,290円、元祖濃厚煮干しそば990円、味玉1,090円、特製1,290円、手揉み中華そば950円、煮干し油そば890円〜1,190円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): セメントのような灰色の濃厚煮干し、濃すぎずバランスが良い、淡麗は醤油が前に出て煮干しは弱いという声、細いストレートの自家製麺、並・大盛り・替え玉無料、曜日ごとのトッピングサービス、紙エプロンの汚れが気になったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine with a short menu; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with a menu updated September 2026; reviews dated July–October 2026.

tokyo_katsu_yoshi_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded, deep-fried cutlets, croquettes and fried shrimp.
tokyo_katsu_yoshi_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork tonkatsu restaurant.
tokyo_katsu_yoshi_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — a line forms before 11:30 on weekdays, and phones can be hard to get through (October 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners only); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 19 seats: 7 at the ground-floor counter in front of the fryer, 12 at tables upstairs (Tabelog). Non-smoking. In a renovated old house down an alley (October 2026). Opened 1 November 2016 (Tabelog).
tokyo_katsu_yoshi_ningyocho.notes: [Tonkatsu · Ningyocho, a celebrated tonkatsu counter in a renovated house] A tonkatsu restaurant in a renovated old house down an alley near Ningyocho station, on Tabelog's Tonkatsu 100 list six times between 2018 and 2026. Sit at the seven-seat counter downstairs to watch each cutlet breaded and fried; tables are upstairs. Loin and fillet cost the same by weight (¥1,925 for 110 g in October 2026), with rice and nuka pickles ordered separately and refilled free. The meat comes rosy, tender and sweet-fatted under a light crust, eaten with salt, plum salt, sauce or wasabi soy. A ¥4,950 course adds a croquette, simmered fillet and a soft-shell-turtle curry to pour over the last of the katsu. Book: a line forms before opening. One October 2026 diner found the batter heavier than before. Closed Sundays.

roles: Chef (unnamed; "carefully prepares and fries each piece at the counter", October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 November 2016 (Tabelog). Selected for Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026. An October 2026 reviewer describes it as recognised by the Michelin Bib Gourmand; that is the reviewer's claim. Website katuyoshi.com (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Loin and fillet tonkatsu by weight; soft-shell-turtle curry.

anecdotes.text: "I was pleasantly surprised to find that the pork loin cutlet and tenderloin cutlet were offered in equal portions at nearly the same price (usually, the tenderloin is more expensive)." — October 2026.
"To finish off, the soft-shelled turtle curry was served, transforming the tonkatsu and rice into a delightful soft-shelled turtle katsu curry." — October 2026, course A ¥4,950.
"At 11:30, there was already a line before opening. I was the seventh in line but was seated during the first round." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かつ好、とんかつ、日本橋人形町3-4-11、人形町駅から徒歩2分、月〜土11:30〜14:00、17:30〜20:30、日曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR不可、19席 (1階カウンター7席、2階テーブル12席)、禁煙、古民家、2016年11月1日オープン、とんかつ 百名店 2018・2019・2021・2022・2024・2026、ホームページ katuyoshi.com。メニュー (2023年8月): ロースかつ110g 1,705円から、ヒレかつ110g 1,925円から、特選250g 4,015円・4,290円、しゃぶ巻きかつ、すっぽんカレー660円。口コミ(2026年10月): ロースとヒレが同じ値段、ご飯と漬物330円 (大盛り・おかわり無料)、味噌汁275円、定食はなく単品で、Aコース4,950円 (オニオンサラダ、コロッケ、ヒレの煮物、とんかつ、すっぽんカレー、抹茶アイス)、塩、梅塩、ソース、わさび醤油、開店前から行列、予約がおすすめ、衣が多かったという声も。

tokyo_sushi_koike_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A set of chawanmushi, tamagoyaki, nigiri, a mini eel bowl, miso soup and a roll; the eel, marinated tuna and soup use soy-based seasonings, and nothing is called gluten-free.
tokyo_sushi_koike_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish sushi counter.
tokyo_sushi_koike_ningyocho.hours_raw: Tue 17:00–22:00; Wed–Sun 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations essential, online via Ikkyu; lunch is booked up about a month ahead (2026 reviews). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats at an L-shaped counter; second floor, stairs only (Tabelog; April 2026). Non-smoking. Opened 16 May 2023 (September 2026 review).
tokyo_sushi_koike_ningyocho.notes: [Sushi · Ningyocho, an eight-seat counter with a ¥3,850 sushi lunch] Up a flight of stairs behind the Ningyocho crossing, an eight-seat L-shaped counter opened in 2023 by a chef from a sushi bar near Marunouchi's Nijubashi (September 2026). The cheerful chef and the warmth of the room keep diners coming back; one has been 31 times. The draw is lunch. For ¥3,850 the "usual" brings chawanmushi, tamagoyaki, about eight thick-cut nigiri on generous rice, a mini eel bowl, miso soup and a negitoro roll. It books out about a month ahead, so reserve on Ikkyu. Dinner is a ¥12,100 nigiri course or a ¥16,500 omakase heavy on small dishes for sake drinkers. A June 2026 regular says it lacks high-end finesse but shines on value. Lunch Wednesday to Sunday; closed Mondays.

roles: Chef (unnamed; "the chef here comes from a sushi bar near Marunouchi Nijubashi", September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 May 2023 (September 2026 review). Two accounts of who runs it: an April 2026 regular describes the chef and two women on staff; a September 2026 reviewer calls it "run by a husband-and-wife team"; an October 2026 diner mentions "the chef and the owner". Prices on Tabelog as of October 2026: lunch "usual" ¥3,850, lunch omakase ¥7,150, dinner nigiri ¥12,100, dinner omakase ¥16,500.
chef_bio.specialty: The ¥3,850 "usual" sushi lunch; thick-cut toppings.

anecdotes.text: "The fish is thick, the rice is slightly larger, and the wasabi served is of excellent quality." — August 2026, fifth visit.
"Two-thirds of the course consists of appetizers, making it a heavenly sushi spot for those who enjoy drinking." — August 2026, omakase.
"While it may not have the technical finesse of high-end establishments, this place stands out for its quality at such a reasonable price." — June 2026.

tokyo_gg_kuramae_ecute_ueno.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee, tea and lattes are the core, but nothing is described as gluten-free; the food is cheesecake, scones and Pelican-bread toast.
tokyo_gg_kuramae_ecute_ueno.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, Earl Grey and orange tea are on the menu, but plant milk is not mentioned in the sources; lattes and the food use dairy, eggs or butter.
tokyo_gg_kuramae_ecute_ueno.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–21:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Inside the JR Ueno ticket gates, 3F (ecute Ueno). No reservations. About 10 counter seats (Tabelog: 10 seats); seats are few, so expect to wait at busy times. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB), transport IC and PayPay. Takeout. Opened 24 April 2025 (Tabelog).
tokyo_gg_kuramae_ecute_ueno.notes: [Café · inside Ueno Station, coffee in a bear bottle] A tiny café inside the JR Ueno ticket gates, the station branch of a Kuramae coffee and bar, opened in April 2025. Its draw is the bear-shaped "Kuma bottle": lattes, matcha latte and teas come in a resealable bear you can rinse and take home (about ¥850 with a drink in 2026), alongside regular cups from ¥700. Food is light — the cheesecake from the Kuramae shop, scones and honey-butter toast on Pelican bread — and the shelves sell bear-themed goods. With about ten seats it is often full; one September 2026 diner found the scones reheated rather than freshly baked as advertised. Card, IC and PayPay.

chef_bio.background: Reviews describe it as the station branch of a popular café in Kuramae, whose cheesecake has been popular since the Kuramae shop opened (August 2026). The listing's website is gg-genie.com. No source names the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Drinks in a bear bottle; cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: "The Kuma bottle offers a larger serving, but if you ask the staff, you can take it home after shaking it up." — September 2026, matcha latte ¥830.
"I visited with the expectation of enjoying freshly baked scones. However, what I received were scones that had just been reheated, not freshly made." — September 2026.
"On my way out, the staff kindly asked if I wanted to rinse the container." — October 2026, iced caramel latte in the bear container, about ¥850.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: COFFEE & BAR gg KURAMAE エキュート上野店、上野7-1-1 JR上野駅改札内 3F、毎日9:00〜21:00、予約不可、10席、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master・JCB)・交通系IC・PayPay 可、2025年4月24日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): Kuramae の人気カフェの駅ナカ店、くまの形のボトル (持ち帰れる)、アイスカフェラテ700円、オレンジティー720円、チーズケーキ、抹茶ラテ (くまボトル) 830円、カフェラテ700円、ミルクティー720円、席が少なく待つことも、くまのグッズ、アールグレイ、Pelican のパンのハニーバタートースト、アフォガート、スコーンは焼きたてではなく温め直しだったという声、くまの容器入りのドリンク約850円 (ガラス約1,200円)、容器をすすいでくれる。

tokyo_menya_tenno_higashiueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-made wheat noodles in seafood-tonkotsu, miso and sesame soups, with gyoza.
tokyo_menya_tenno_higashiueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and pork-bone soups, chashu and egg toppings.
tokyo_menya_tenno_higashiueno.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:30); closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations. Ticket machine takes cash only; for cashless (QR) payment order at the table and pay after (July 2026); Tabelog lists no cards or e-money. 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Diners in March, August and September 2026 found the shop's cleanliness lacking (coughing staff, a smell, greasy tables).
tokyo_menya_tenno_higashiueno.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Ueno, cheap tsukemen with a free large size] A plain noodle shop three minutes from the Iriya exit of Ueno Station, serving tsukemen, ramen and abura-soba on house-made noodles you can have thick or thin, with the large size free. Prices are low for 2026: seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen ¥790, abura-soba ¥720, miso ramen ¥860 (gyoza and rice +¥300) and draft beer ¥360. Diners liked the chewy noodles, the balanced seafood-pork dip and the value; others in 2026 found the flavour faint, the 'free large' closer to a medium, and the room greasy and not very clean. The listing calls it the Ueno branch of a Tabata shop; a July 2026 diner says the Tabata branch has closed. Cash at the machine, QR at the table. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing's remarks, the Ueno branch of Menya Tenno in Tabata-Shinmachi, Kita-ku; a July 2026 review says "The Tabata branch has closed." No source names the owner or gives an opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Tsukemen; abura-soba.

anecdotes.text: "The balance of seafood and pork bone flavors was excellent, and it paired perfectly with the homemade noodles." — July 2026, tsukemen.
"While the large size is free, it wasn't that large—more like a typical medium size (about 300 grams). The most concerning aspect was the smell inside the restaurant." — August 2026, tsukemen ¥790.
"The ticket vending machine only accepts cash. If you prefer cashless payment, you can order at the table and pay later." — July 2026, abura-soba ¥720.

tokyo_motocho_soba_higashiueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba and udon in a soy-and-bonito broth, with wheat-batter tempura, croquettes and curry; the soba's buckwheat ratio is not stated.
tokyo_motocho_soba_higashiueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dipping sauce and broth are bonito dashi; toppings include squid and shrimp tempura, chikuwa and raw egg.
tokyo_motocho_soba_higashiueno.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and holidays 6:00–21:00; closed Saturdays and Sundays (Tabelog). Meal tickets from a vending machine. 13 seats. Non-smoking. No cards; transport IC (Suica) accepted (Tabelog). Tempura is fried to order, so bowls take a few minutes; some tempura sells out by mid-afternoon (October 2026).
tokyo_motocho_soba_higashiueno.notes: [Soba · Higashi-Ueno, a one-man stand soba with noodles made upstairs] A small counter soba-udon shop across Showa-dori from Ueno Station's Iriya exit, open from 6 am on weekdays. It looks like a standing-soba stall, but the thin soba is made daily in the workshop upstairs and boiled to order, and the kakiage, eggplant and squid tempura are fried when you hand over your ticket. The broth is dark and Kanto-style, with bonito. Bowls run ¥560–650; sets add a mini curry (a rich black-roux curry), a kakiage don or salmon rice for ¥750–970. Diners in 2026 praise the noodles and the kind owner, who works alone; one diner found it not the cleanest, another the noodles a bit soft. Closed weekends.

roles: Owner, works alone (October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Reviews in September 2026 say the noodles are made fresh every day in the shop's noodle workshop on the second floor; an October 2026 diner saw the owner working alone, and a September 2026 diner found the owner very kind. chef_bio.specialty: Thin house-made soba; kakiage.

anecdotes.text: "I heard that the noodles are made on the second floor in their noodle factory and served fresh. The noodles have a wonderful soba flavor and are delicious." — September 2026, chilled tempura soba ¥610.

"At a typical standing soba shop, the food would be served almost instantly, but here they take the time to boil the soba and fry the kakiage after you place your order." — September 2026, kakiage soba ¥560.
"The owner, who was working alone, had a great vibe." — October 2026, daily set.

tokyo_mendokoro_kaishin_roppongi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles ("I taste the flavor of wheat", October 2026); the menu also has a chicken shoyu ramen.
tokyo_mendokoro_kaishin_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: clam and seafood broth, pork and chicken chashu, egg.
tokyo_mendokoro_kaishin_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:30–06:30 (last order 06:00); Fri–Sat 11:30–07:00 (last order 06:30); Sun 11:30–04:30 (last order 04:00) (Tabelog). Card or QR payment means ordering on your phone at the counter and registering a card (October 2026). 19 seats: 11 at the counter and two tables for 4. Non-smoking. Cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). Children welcome. Opened 28 June 2023 (Tabelog).
tokyo_mendokoro_kaishin_roppongi.notes: [Ramen · Roppongi, clam shio ramen by the crossing until dawn] A 19-seat ramen shop right at Roppongi crossing that stays open from 11:30 am until 6:30 or 7 the next morning. The draw is a clear, gentle shio broth packed with the umami of clams and seafood, ultra-thin straight noodles, a big clam on top and a choice of chashu — from a ¥1,100 bowl to a ¥2,200 version with three kinds of chashu, egg and white truffle oil, an oil one diner found sharp enough to divide opinion. There is a chicken shoyu ramen too, which a returning diner found less special than the clam bowl. Reviewers in 2026 note friendly staff from overseas, slow service on a training night, and a mobile ordering step if you pay by card. A reviewer believes the shop was earlier called Tsunagu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 28 June 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer believes the shop was earlier named "Tsunagu", with the same interior. Diners in September and October 2026 describe the staff as from overseas. No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Clam-and-seafood shio ramen.

anecdotes.text: "Despite being a clear and refreshing salt soup, it had remarkable depth, and each sip left a luxurious aftertaste." — September 2026, the ¥2,200 deluxe bowl.
"The white truffle oil had a strong acidity and made a bold statement, which might be a bit too intense for some, potentially dividing opinions." — October 2026.
"I ordered the chicken-based shoyu ramen, which was delicious at the previous location… the 'Clam Shio' had a rich flavor with a deep umami." — October 2026.

tokyo_mezzo_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free; the food is bar dishes such as fried chicken, carbonara, pizza and rice croquettes (2025–2026 reviews).
tokyo_mezzo_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dishes named are fried chicken, carbonara, a wagyu-and-egg-yolk rice bowl and pizza; no plant dish is described.
tokyo_mezzo_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the day before a holiday 18:00–05:00; closed Sundays and public holidays (Tabelog). 1F: casual bar with a DJ, no entrance fee except on special days. 2F: lounge with sofas and private rooms; à la carte carries a table charge (Tabelog gives both "¥2,000 per table and up" and "¥5,000 per table"; an October 2025 group paid about ¥5,000), courses have no charge. Drinks ¥500 until 21:00 (September 2025); an all-you-can-drink for women at ¥1,000 (March 2026). 17 seats listed; up to 80 seated and 120 standing for hire. Non-smoking, with a separate smoking area; complimentary heated-tobacco devices were offered (October 2025). Children only with an exclusive booking. Cards, IC/e-money and QR. Opened 29 July 2017 (Tabelog).
tokyo_mezzo_roppongi.notes: [Bar · Roppongi, a DJ bar with food until 5 am] A minute from Roppongi crossing, a two-floor bar: downstairs a casual bar with a DJ booth and a terrace, upstairs a marble-and-black lounge with sofas and private rooms for parties. It runs from 6 pm to 5 am, Monday to Saturday, filling up after 10 pm with a young, international crowd that sometimes dances. Drinks are cheap early (¥500 until 9 pm in September 2025) and there is a proper food menu — fried chicken, carbonara, pizza, rice croquettes and a photogenic wagyu tamago-kake-gohan. Upstairs à la carte carries a table charge; one July 2025 guest found the staff pushy about refills. Smoking room; children only for private hire.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 July 2017 (Tabelog). The Tabelog text describes a casual 1F bar and a 2F lounge of marble and black with private rooms; a July 2025 diner heard it used to be a one-coin bar. The official site returned an error on 2026-11-02.
chef_bio.philosophy: A refined adult night out a minute from Roppongi crossing (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Late-night DJ bar; wagyu tamago-kake-gohan.

tokyo_kicko_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free; the courses mix nigiri with dashi-based kaiseki dishes, Shaoxing-wine-marinated shrimp, tempura, fried cod roe and soy-based seasoning (2025–2026 reviews).
tokyo_kicko_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi kaiseki of fish, shellfish, crab and whale.
tokyo_kicko_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and days around holidays 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; also irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservation only; same-day bookings by phone only; same-day cancellations charged the full course. Prices include a 10% service charge; no cover. 8 seats: a hinoki counter of 4 and a private room for 4. Heated tobacco only in the private room. Cards; no e-money or QR. English menu; English- and Chinese-speaking staff. Children welcome; a children's menu from ¥5,000 by reservation (Tabelog).
tokyo_kicko_roppongi.notes: [Sushi · Roppongi, a sushi kaiseki from an owner-chef with a past in China and Okinawa] A long-running Roppongi obanzai kaiseki turned sushi kaiseki in 2023 under owner-chef 笠井 (Kasai, as Tabelog writes it), with a hinoki counter of four and a private room for four. The chef, from Muroran per a 2025 diner, has cooked in China and Okinawa, and courses mix small kaiseki plates — botan shrimp in Shaoxing wine, a hairy-crab chawanmushi with homemade karasumi, oden in autumn, sometimes whale — with nigiri on lightly red-vinegared rice, ending in a crab-and-sea-urchin risotto. Courses run from about ¥15,000 to ¥28,000 including service. Diners in 2025–2026 found the chef gruff at first and warm once talking; one heard a newcomer scolded behind the scenes. English- and Chinese-speaking staff; heated tobacco only in the private room.

roles: Owner-chef (official site: "店主 笠井"; Tabelog: "Chef Kasai")
chef_bio.origin: Muroran (an October 2025 diner, as told by the chef)
chef_bio.background: The official site signs its greeting "店主 笠井"; the Tabelog text credits "Chef Kasai", with a name made "in culinary cities both domestically and internationally", with the 2023 renewal of the obanzai kaiseki Kikkō into a sushi kaiseki. An October 2025 diner heard from the chef about the origin of the shop's name, work in China and Okinawa, fish sourcing, a love of sake and a hometown of Muroran.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients chosen daily from fishing grounds and markets around Japan, served with heartfelt hospitality (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi kaiseki; hairy-crab chawanmushi; crab-and-uni risotto.

anecdotes.text: "The head chef had a tough exterior, but… turned out to be a friendly and wonderful person once we started talking." — October 2025, Kō course ¥21,780.
"The chawanmushi is generously made with hairy crab, topped with plenty of karasumi (dried mullet roe)!" — October 2025.
"While we were in a private room, I could hear a staff member speaking harshly to a newcomer, which made me a bit concerned." — October 2025.

tokyo_sushi_shishido_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Edomae sushi omakase.

A 10% seat charge on à la carte-only orders (Tabelog). Tell the shop about allergies when booking. 10 counter seats (up to 12). Non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), IC/e-money and QR. Children welcome. Opened 9 August 2026 (Tabelog).
tokyo_sushi_shishido_roppongi.notes: [Sushi · Roppongi, an Edomae omakase that runs until 5 am] A sleek black counter of ten, four minutes from Roppongi Station, that opened in August 2026 and serves an Edomae omakase from 6 pm to 5 am. The chef has 18 years of experience, including work in Taiwan and Malaysia (shop text), and a September 2026 diner says the chef has opened sushi shops overseas. The ¥30,000 course runs to about 16–18 plates mixing nigiri — chutoro, otoro, marinated akami, sweet shrimp, seared sardine — with cooked dishes such as grilled swordfish, a white-fish meunière with Japanese salsa and a showpiece of salmon roe, sea urchin and caviar; a ¥50,000 special course uses finer fish. Diners in 2026 praise a friendly chef and generous portions; late at night it doubles as a karaoke bar.

tokyo_hirugao_ningyocho.notes: [Ramen · Ningyocho, Setagaya-group shio ramen on the main road] The Ningyocho branch of Hirugao, the shio-ramen shop of the Setagaya group, two minutes from the station. Its signature is a clear, golden salt broth of chicken layered with kombu, dried scallop, niboshi and bonito, with thin noodles, thick tender chashu and plump shrimp wontons. Diners in October 2026 found it light yet full of umami. In autumn 2026 the branch also served its own limited back-fat niboshi ramen (¥1,050), with thick curly noodles and a Jiro-style question about garlic. Add the ¥430 oyakodon if hungry. One October 2026 diner thought the special tsukemen skimpy. Cash only; open daily, closing at 17:00 on Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Part of the Setagaya group: Tabelog links the group site setaga-ya.com/store/hirugao. An October 2026 diner calls Hirugao "the well-known and popular ramen chain", and another notes it was featured on Tokyo Station's Ramen Street. Opened 23 April 2018 (Tabelog). The back-fat niboshi ramen is a Ningyocho-only limited dish (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Shio ramen with shrimp wontons.

tokyo_himalayan_village_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Ask. The dal bhat set has a bean curry, sautéed spinach and a potato dish (September 2026), but how the curries and vegetables are cooked is not described, and most sets centre on chicken, mutton or keema.
tokyo_himalayan_village_ningyocho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), open on holidays (Tabelog). Lunch sets with free refills of naan and rice; spice level to order (2026 reviews). Party courses with all-you-can-eat and -drink; private hire for up to 50 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay; no service charge (Tabelog). 28 seats incl. sofas and a counter; non-smoking, smoking outside (Tabelog). Basement. Opened 12 May 2008; 18th anniversary in May 2026 (Tabelog; October 2026 review).
tokyo_himalayan_village_ningyocho.notes: [Curry · Ningyocho, a long-running Nepalese curry basement by the station] A basement Nepalese restaurant half a minute from Ningyocho station, open daily since 2008. At lunch it fills with office workers for a ¥950 set of two curries with fluffy naan and rice, both refilled free. One October 2026 diner prized it as the only place around serving dal bhat (¥1,180), a bean curry with spinach, potato and rice on golden dishware. Mutton curry, keema and a cheese naan are favourites. Ask for spice by level, as level 1 can be very mild. In the evening it turns into a lively party venue, with all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from ¥3,000, and an August 2026 diner found half the room were foreign visitors. Nepalese and Indian beers.

roles: Nepalese chef (unnamed; Tabelog shop text)

tokyo_yoshiume_yoshimachitei_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kaiseki courses with sashimi, a dashi-based negima hot pot finished as rice porridge, miso-marinated fish and tempura on some courses; nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_yoshiume_yoshimachitei_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature hot pot is tuna and leek in broth, and courses are built on fish.
tokyo_yoshiume_yoshimachitei_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the days before and after a holiday 11:30–14:00 (last order food 13:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order food 20:30); closed Sat, Sun and holidays; no reservations taken for weekends and holidays (Tabelog). Courses booked ahead. Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). 16 seats in private rooms for 2–8, some tatami with sunken seating; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking. Traditional performing-arts events at times — a Satsuma biwa recital with a kaiseki bento in October 2025.
tokyo_yoshiume_yoshimachitei_ningyocho.notes: [Kaiseki · Ningyocho, Edo negima hot pot in a registered cultural-property house] Down a narrow alley near Ningyocho station, a pre-war house registered as a tangible cultural property. Tabelog says it was once the home of the actress Hanayagi Kokiku, with a Yakusugi cedar ceiling, wave-patterned glass, fine latticework and a sunken garden. Diners eat in private rooms, one party per room. The specialty is negima nabe, the Edo hot pot of tuna and sweet white leek in broth, cooked at the table by seasoned staff and finished as rice porridge, within kaiseki courses of seasonal dishes (¥16,000–24,000 plus 10%). Diners in 2025–26 describe it as a quiet, Showa-era ryotei for business dinners and special occasions; an October 2026 diner thanked the owner for the welcome, and in 2025 the owner explained the building's history before a biwa recital. Weekdays only.

roles: Owner (unnamed; explained the building's history at an October 2025 event; "the staff, including the owner", October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text: a beautiful building once home to the actress Hanayagi Kokiku, with a ceiling of Yakusugi cedar, wave-pattern glass, latticework and a tokonoma pillar; a registered tangible cultural property (pre-war); Edo's famous negima nabe and seasonal Japanese dishes; traditional performing-arts events. tokyo_ningyocho_densui.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, dashimaki and the clay-pot rice may suit, but the menu includes croquettes, tempura, saikyo-miso fish and tsukudani, and nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_ningyocho_densui.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi underlies the soups, simmered dishes and dashimaki (August 2026), and the courses centre on fish.
tokyo_ningyocho_densui.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sat 11:30–14:00 and 16:00–22:00; closed Sundays, holidays, 31 December–3 January and 11–13 August; hours may change (Tabelog). Evening bookings go first to guests who will drink sake; for food only, come at lunch; the Jimbocho branch takes overflow (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: 4 at the counter, 14 at tables; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Second floor. Lunch rice is refillable (September 2026). Opened 18 September 2009 per Tabelog; 2026 reviews give 2001 and October 2010.
tokyo_ningyocho_densui.notes: [Izakaya · Ningyocho, a sake lover's kaiseki izakaya with truffle clay-pot rice] Up a stair on an alley corner between Ningyocho and Suitengumae, an 18-seat second-floor room built around sake, whose name speaks of being drunk on the blessings of the rice fields. Evening tables go first to people who will drink. The owner pairs sake from a deep list of new-wave and junmai brews, and an August 2026 diner watched the owner run the kitchen single-handed. Dishes are made for drinking: the signature hassun of nine seasonal bites, sashimi, a beef-and-porcini croquette, dashimaki. The finish is black-truffle clay-pot rice, the leftovers sometimes shaped into rice balls to take home. Weekday lunch sets of grilled black cod or sashimi come with dashimaki and refillable rice; one August 2026 diner found them small for the price. Closed Sundays.

roles: Owner, cooking alone in the kitchen (unnamed; "Despite being a one-man operation in the kitchen, the owner's skill was evident", August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: run by a company reviewers call Tokyo Food Works, with branches in Otemachi and Jimbocho (July 2026; Tabelog names the Jimbocho shop as overflow); an August 2026 reviewer names the company's representative as Shingo Sasada. Opening year differs: Tabelog gives 18 September 2009; a July 2026 review says 2001; August and October 2026 reviews say October 2010. Website densui.net (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sake as one of the main attractions of the meal, not a side ("Kokushu Kaiseki", October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Densui hassun; black-truffle clay-pot rice; sake pairing.

anecdotes.text: "The leftover black truffle rice in the clay pot was made into onigiri (rice balls) by the owner, which was a delightful service that allowed me to take it home." — August 2026, kaiseki course.
"I had the pleasure of tasting various brands such as Saku, Ki, Oomine, Jikon, and Aramasa—truly a delight for sake lovers." — October 2026.
"Delicious, but a bit lacking." — August 2026, chilled-soup lunch set ¥1,650.

tokyo_trattoria_don_giovanni_yotsuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as served: every lunch is built on wheat pasta with bread or baguette; nothing gluten-free is mentioned.
tokyo_trattoria_don_giovanni_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. The daily one-plate comes with ham, rillettes, chicken or pork and pasta sauces with meat, crab or cream; the salad and bean dishes are the only plant items named.
tokyo_trattoria_don_giovanni_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat lunch 11:30–14:30; closed Sunday (Tabelog, which lists no dinner hours; one December 2025 diner had used it for a party). Weekday lunch is busy, Saturdays calmer (May 2026). Up stairs on the third floor (March 2026). 20 seats at a counter, tables and sofas; whole-shop hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Tabelog lists cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), but a March 2026 diner was told lunch is cash only. Opened 1 April 2014 (Tabelog).
tokyo_trattoria_don_giovanni_yotsuya.notes: [Italian · Yotsuya, a third-floor trattoria with a ¥1,000 plate] Up the stairs on the third floor of a Shinmichi-dōri building, a white-walled trattoria with a counter, tables and sofas; the listing says the chef trained at Michelin-starred restaurants in Italy and at well-known Tokyo kitchens. Lunch is the reason 2025–26 diners come: a one-plate of appetizers, a salad with beans and ham, bread, the day's thin spaghetti and a meat main for ¥1,000, which most found more than filling, or a ¥1,500 course with antipasti, a pasta such as blue crab in tomato cream, and tiramisu. Many solo diners, men and women, sit at the counter, and service is quick. Weekdays fill up; Saturdays are calmer. Lunch only on Tabelog's hours; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog remarks: "A restaurant run by a chef who has trained at Michelin-starred Restaurants in Italy and famous restaurants in Tokyo." No source names the chef.
chef_bio.specialty: One-plate lunch; blue crab tomato-cream spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the one-plate lunch (JPY 1000) that included an appetizer, salad, pasta, and a main dish… It was more filling than I expected." — August 2025, a working Saturday.
"I chose the spaghetti with tomato cream sauce and blue crab from three options… plenty of crab mixed in a creamy tomato sauce." — January 2026, ¥1,700 with large pasta.
"During lunch hours, there were many solo diners, both men and women." — October 2025.

tokyo_takumi_kami_miso_ramen_yotsuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a miso broth; gyoza and kara-age on the side.
tokyo_takumi_kami_miso_ramen_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the miso soup is topped with a layer of lard and chashu; a clam salt ramen is the other broth named.
tokyo_takumi_kami_miso_ramen_yotsuya.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours. Reviews show lunch on weekdays and holidays (around 13:00) and late nights (open at about 22:00 on weekdays; "they stay open fairly late at night", June 2023). Order by voice, no ticket machine (April 2026). 19 seats: four tables for four and three counter seats, some booths with acrylic screens (July 2026) (Tabelog). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Tabelog lists cards, e-money and QR; a July 2026 diner paid cash. Opened 6 December 2021 (Tabelog).
tokyo_takumi_kami_miso_ramen_yotsuya.notes: [Ramen · Yotsuya, Sapporo miso on Shinmichi-dōri, late] A plain 19-seat ramen shop on Shinmichi-dōri serving Sapporo-style aged-miso ramen: a rich miso soup kept scalding under a layer of lard, chewy medium-thick curly yellow noodles and a heap of stir-fried vegetables, with a slice of seared chashu. Variations run from miso butter corn and spicy green-onion miso to a mapo miso and a clam salt ramen, all around ¥850–990, and at lunch a small rice bowl costs ¥150. After 2026 drinking nights people drop in near 22:00 for a bowl and a highball; one diner from Kansai was pleased to find Hokkaido-style miso butter corn. Opinions run from rich and warming to ordinary, with one bowl gone lukewarm under its vegetables. Order by voice; tables and a short counter.

chef_bio.background: No source names the owner or cooks; no website found. A web search found no other shop of the name.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged-miso ramen; miso butter corn.

anecdotes.text: "The broth has a layer of lard that keeps it hot until the very last bite." — April 2026, miso butter corn ramen ¥950.
"In Kansai, it's rare to find Hokkaido-style miso corn butter ramen, so I was really pleased." — April 2026, after a concert.
"I ordered the Ajitama Miso Ramen for JPY 950 and a Mega Highball… The soup was piping hot!" — April 2026, just before 22:00.

tokyo_washoku_dining_jikishin_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. No allergy information. Sashimi and grilled tuna collar are the core, but courses finish with noodles or ramen, the hot pots use a soy or dashi broth, and a soy-marinated egg yolk is the usual starter (2026 reviews).
tokyo_washoku_dining_jikishin_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. The listing ticks "Vegetarian options" and "particular about vegetables", but courses centre on fish, Tokyo X pork and Hinai chicken, and no vegan dish is named.
tokyo_washoku_dining_jikishin_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 15:30–23:30; Sat–Sun 15:00–22:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). October 2026 diners also ate lunch here (Hiroshima tsukemen; a salmon and mackerel miso set just after 13:00); lunch hours are not listed. Reservations taken; courses with all-you-can-drink sake (bottles brought to the table to pour) ¥5,500–6,500; half-price sake days, pours from 120 ml (180 ml on half-price days) (2025–26 reviews). 42 seats: counter, tables, tatami and sunken seating; private rooms for 4 to 30+; hire for 20–50; heated-tobacco-only smoking area (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (Tabelog). BYO and takeaway possible (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2007 (Tabelog).
tokyo_washoku_dining_jikishin_yotsuya.notes: [Izakaya · Yotsuya, a basement sake bar with tuna collar and Tokyo X pork] A basement izakaya on Shinmichi-dōri, open since 2007, built for sake: the shop says it keeps more than 60 bottles from across the country chosen beyond the famous names, and on the drinks courses staff set three one-sho bottles on the table and swap them when empty. The kitchen buys fish from Toyosu; the house signatures are bluefin tuna collar, raw and grilled, and Tokyo X pork shabu-shabu, finished with noodles, ramen or zosui. A soy-marinated egg yolk starter, mackerel prosciutto and a sesame salad with Shine Muscat grapes caught 2026 diners' eyes, and on half-price sake days a pour starts at 180 ml. Mostly courses for company parties of 4 to 30 in tatami and private rooms, from about ¥5,500 with drinks. One July 2026 group found the ingredients unremarkable. Lately also open for lunch, with Hiroshima-style tsukemen.

chef_bio.background: No source names the owner or cooks. Corporate-member Tabelog listing: high-quality seasonal ingredients such as tuna, hairy crab, kinmedai, soft roe and monkfish liver from Yoichi; specialities of grilled and sashimi tuna collar and Tokyo X pork shabu-shabu; "over 60 unique sake varieties sourced from across the country, not limited by popularity"; fish sourced directly from Toyosu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Courses and all-you-can-drink without compromise on ingredients or sake (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Bluefin tuna collar; Tokyo X pork shabu-shabu; sake.

anecdotes.text: "They brought out three bottles of Japanese sake at a time, and after enjoying those, I could exchange them for new ones! I tried 9 different kinds over three rounds, and by the end, my hand was shaking from holding the one-sho bottle (laughs)." — October 2026.
"I visited on a day when they had half-price sake. Although the minimum order is 120ml, on half-price days, it starts from 180ml." — June 2026.
"During the day, they used to serve only Hiroshima Tsukemen… To my surprise, I found that Hiroshima Tsukemen is still on the menu!" — October 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 直心 (Washoku Dining Jikishin)、居酒屋・魚介・日本酒バー、四谷1-7 第二鹿倉ビルB1F、月〜金15:30〜23:30、土日15:00〜22:00、不定休、42席、カウンター・テーブル・座敷・掘りごたつ、個室4〜30名以上、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙所、カード・QR 可、持ち込み・テイクアウト可、2007年7月1日オープン、本鮪、毛蟹、金目鯛、白子、Yoichi のあん肝、鮪のカマの刺身と焼き、Tokyo X の豚しゃぶ、全国の日本酒60種以上、Toyosu から直送の魚。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 一升瓶3本をテーブルに置く日本酒の飲み放題、コース5,500〜6,500円、日本酒半額の日、卵黄の醤油漬け、鯖の生ハム、シャインマスカットの白ごま和え、土鍋ごはん、昼の Hiroshima のつけ麺と魚の定食。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly booked courses; the staff choose the sake for you (June 2026).

tokyo_grill_bistro_k_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled chicken, duck and beef are the mains, but sauces are not described; lunches are pasta or a European-style beef curry, courses include a baguette, and a financier or madeleine follows lunch (2026 reviews; Tabelog course).
tokyo_grill_bistro_k_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. Salads (Caesar with soft-boiled egg), a seasonal vegetable potage and an asparagus cheese gratin are the vegetable dishes named; the menu is built on meat.
tokyo_grill_bistro_k_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:30 (last order 21:30); Sat, Sun and holidays dinner only; closed Tuesday and occasional other days (Tabelog). Lunch started in early 2026 (April 2026 review). Reservations taken; dishes take time with one person in charge (July 2026, October 2026). 18 seats: 8 at the counter, tables; hire for up to 20; non-smoking; basement can feel chilly (January 2026) (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Tabelog's Japanese text gives no service charge ("なし"), though its English translation mentions 10%. Smart-casual dress asked; children welcome, no kids' menu (Tabelog). Opened 11 October 2024 (Tabelog).
tokyo_grill_bistro_k_yotsuya.notes: [French · Yotsuya, a one-person meat-and-wine bistro in a basement] Down in a brown-toned basement off Sanei-dōri, an 18-seat bistro opened in October 2024 where, as diners describe it, one smiling owner cooks, pours and serves, and sees guests to the door. The owner is a certified sommelier (January 2025), and the menu is meat: charcoal-grilled jidori chicken with crackling skin, duck, beef, a white-liver terrine and a foie gras brûlée, plus the green asparagus cheese gratin several diners single out. The ¥7,000 prix-fixe lets you choose the main; lunch, added in 2026, is a beef-stew-like European curry or a duck or chicken Bolognese, with a small cake to finish. Dishes take time, so come unhurried. Closed Tuesdays; weekends dinner only.

roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (reviews: "The chef is also a certified sommelier", January 2025; "the owner is managing everything alone", July 2026)
chef_bio.background: No source names the owner. "Charming smile from the owner even while working solo… It seems like the owner is managing everything alone" (July 2026); "The chef kindly saw us off at the door despite being busy" (January 2026); "The chef is also a certified sommelier" (January 2025). Corporate-member Tabelog listing: carefully selected chicken, duck and beef steaks; the European-style beef curry is the speciality; wines suggested by the sommelier.
chef_bio.philosophy: Specialty meat dishes that bring out the ingredients' natural flavour (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled jidori chicken and duck; asparagus cheese gratin; European-style beef curry.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, I was greeted by the owner's wonderful smile… It seems like the owner is managing everything alone, and if that's the case, I truly want to support such a place." — July 2026, with a son who had just turned 20.
"It seems they informed the restaurant about one of us being pregnant, as they kindly served the soft-boiled egg for the Caesar salad separately." — July 2026.
"Personally, I was completely hooked on the green asparagus cheese gratin." — May 2026.
