tokyo_tsutaya_soba_ueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the soba is not described as 100% buckwheat (a 2026 reviewer smelled both wheat and buckwheat), and there are udon, tempura, curry and katsudon; the tsuyu is soy-based.
tokyo_tsutaya_soba_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba and udon in a bonito-based tsuyu, with meat, duck, egg and seafood toppings.
tokyo_tsutaya_soba_ueno.hours_raw: Official site: lunch Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30, Sat and holidays 11:00–14:00; dinner Mon–Fri 17:30–20:00; lunch closed Sundays, dinner closed Sat, Sun and holidays. The shop's 24 September 2026 notice lists lunch closing days as Sundays and holidays, ends service when food runs out, and says dinner resumed on 5 October 2026 after a September with reduced hours and menu. Tabelog gives the same weekday times. Evening reservations only. 16 table seats. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; no e-money. Founded in 1935 (a January 2025 review).
tokyo_tsutaya_soba_ueno.notes: [Soba · Ueno, an Iriya-side soba shop since 1935] An old family-run soba and udon shop just off the tracks near the Iriya exit of Ueno Station, founded in 1935, with a smart entrance and only tables inside. The soba is thin and made from stone-ground buckwheat, with a sweetish tsuyu; diners in 2026 ordered duck seiro, chilled sesame-miso and mekabu soba, and lunch sets of soba with a tamago-don or katsudon. From 5 October winter brings thick-noodle nabeyaki, sukiyaki and miso-nikomi udon and oyster nanban. Bowls run about ¥800–1,700. Lunch only on Saturdays; dinner (weekdays to 8 pm) has oden and soba miso with drinks. The shop cut hours in September 2026 and resumed normal service on 24 September.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 review calls it family-run; a December 2022 visitor chatted with "the friendly owner and the hostess". The shop's notices are signed 店主 (owner). No source names the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Thin stone-ground soba; winter thick udon.

anecdotes.text: "Since the soba here is made from stone-ground buckwheat flour, I thought it would be best to enjoy it cold… the noodles were thin yet had a great chewiness and smooth texture." — March 2026, tamago-don set.
"The soba noodles released a delightful aroma of wheat and buckwheat… the hot dipping sauce infused with the rich flavor of duck." — February 2026, kamo seiro.
"It's a family-run business! The staff were very friendly." — May 2026.

tokyo_nozomiya_ueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: iekei ramen and tsukemen on wheat noodles in a soy tare.
tokyo_nozomiya_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone and chicken soup with chicken oil, chashu and egg.
tokyo_nozomiya_ueno.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–24:00 (last order 23:45); open all year (Tabelog). No reservations. Ticket machine at the entrance. Cash only (no cards or e-money, Tabelog). 12 seats. Smoking allowed except 11:00–14:00 (Tabelog). Weekday lunch: large noodles free (December 2025). Rice: one free bowl (2025–2026 reviews); a December 2025 diner says refills now cost ¥100.
tokyo_nozomiya_ueno.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Ueno, iekei with free rice near the station] A 12-seat Yokohama iekei ramen counter a few minutes from Ueno Station, open from 11 am to midnight every day. Buy a ticket, tell the staff how firm you want the noodles, how much chicken oil and how strong the tare, and eat the rich pork-and-chicken soup with spinach, nori and chashu alongside a free bowl of rice (plain shoyu or shio ¥900 in 2026). Reviews in 2025–2026 split: many like the rich, rice-friendly soup and the value; others found the noodles soft for iekei, the soup scant, a smell from the restroom, and one wrote that the soup is made elsewhere rather than in the shop, while the listing says it is made from domestic pork bones and chicken carcasses. Cash only; smoking allowed after 2 pm.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's listing, the soup uses plenty of domestic pork bones and chicken carcasses; a February 2026 reviewer believed the soup is prepared elsewhere, not in the shop. A December 2025 reviewer had eaten at a Nozomiya in Ota Ward. No source names the owner or gives an opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Iekei tonkotsu-shoyu ramen.

anecdotes.text: "During lunchtime, they offer a free large size and rice as a default, which is really appreciated… This time, I tried the salt flavor." — December 2025.
"The soup is amazing!!! It's not made in-house but prepared elsewhere. You can tell as soon as you walk in by the smell… For a 'Iekei' style, they need to be more chewy." — February 2026.
"Currently, rice is free with the meal. This time, I ordered the regular ramen… At JPY 900, I think it's still a good value considering the free rice." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 希家 上野店、東上野3-39-7 長春堂ビル 1F、日比谷線上野駅から徒歩2分、JR上野駅浅草口・広小路口から徒歩4分、毎日11:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:45)、年中無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、12席、喫煙可 (11時〜14時は禁煙)、国産の豚骨と鶏ガラを使い、麺のかたさ・鶏油・味の濃さを注文時に聞く。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): 平日昼は大盛り無料、ライス1杯無料 (おかわりは100円という声も)、塩ラーメン900円、ほうれん草とのり3枚、スープは店で作っていないという声、麺はもっともちもちがいい、キャベツともやし、Ota Ward の希家にも行ったという人、肉祭り (チャーシュー5枚)、スープが少ない、トイレのにおい、ライスの器の汚れ、ラーメン900円。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; staff ask your noodle, oil and tare preferences.

tokyo_chinchinken_ueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a local Chinese shop of ramen, gyoza, yakisoba and soy-seasoned fried rice.
tokyo_chinchinken_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: lard-fried rice, pork gyoza, chashu and meat soups.
tokyo_chinchinken_ueno.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 10:00–23:00; Sun and holidays 10:00–20:00; closed Mondays (the next day when Monday is a holiday); hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; long queues at weekend lunch (40 minutes to an hour on Sundays in 2026; arriving by about 9:20 suggested). Cash only. 24 seats: a counter for 8 and two tables for two inside, plus tables outside under the tracks. Smoking allowed. Hot in summer and cold in winter outside (November 2026 review).
tokyo_chinchinken_ueno.notes: [Chinese · Ameyoko, open-air fried rice and gyoza under the tracks] A long-running local Chinese restaurant under the railway at Ameyoko, now in its third generation, with a short counter inside and most tables out in the open under the tracks. At weekends a queue forms before the 10 am opening for the plain, lard-sweet fried rice (large is just ¥100 more) and the big, chewy-skinned gyoza made at the front of the shop; diners also order ramen, wonton noodles, tantanmen and liver stir-fry, with a beer. A November 2026 regular warned of hour-long Sunday waits, heat and cold outside, and found the gyoza undercooked that day; others praise the value and the Ueno atmosphere. Cash only; closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 review calls it a long-established local Chinese restaurant in its third generation. A November 2026 review says it was originally known for tantanmen before television made the fried rice famous. No source names the owner or gives an opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Fried rice; gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "The fried rice is almost devoid of ingredients, but the sweetness from the lard is addictive… The gyoza is large, has a homemade feel, and is juicy." — October 2026.
"The large fried rice is 1.5 times the regular size for just an extra JPY 100." — October 2026.
"I went on Sunday at 9:45 and had to wait 40 minutes… The gyoza was undercooked—it wasn't properly fried." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 珍々軒、上野6-12-2、JR上野駅から徒歩3分、御徒町駅から徒歩5分、火〜土10:00〜23:00、日祝10:00〜20:00、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌日)、予約不可、現金のみ、24席 (カウンター8、2名のテーブル2、外に4名のテーブル3など)、喫煙可。メニュー (2022年): チャーハン800円、餃子500円、ラーメン700円、担々麺850円、焼きそば800円、生姜焼きライス900円。口コミ(2026年6月〜11月): 日曜は開店前から行列で40分〜1時間待ち、夏は暑く冬は寒い、海外の客が多い、餃子は焼きが足りなかった、チャーハンが小さかった、もとは担々麺の店だったがテレビでチャーハンが有名に、店の前で包む餃子、チャーシュー、ラードの甘みのチャーハン、大盛りは1.5倍で+100円、塩ラーメン、ワンタン麺、餃子ライス、自家製ラー油、生姜の利いたスープ、三代続く町中華、高架下の屋外の席、レバもやし、焼きそば。

tokyo_jokigen_kitaueno.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled local chicken, sashimi and chilled tofu are on the menu, but nothing is described as gluten-free; there are fried dishes, a closing ramen and seasoned sauces.
tokyo_jokigen_kitaueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and fish sake bar (grilled local chicken, liver, chicken sashimi, fish). Chilled tofu, sliced onion and spicy cucumber are on the menu, but how they are dressed is not stated.
tokyo_jokigen_kitaueno.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:30–23:00 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; phone from 13:00, including to check for a single seat. Two drinks per person minimum (2026 reviews); no table charge. 16 seats around a U-shaped counter (Tabelog; a September 2026 diner guessed about 14). Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR.
tokyo_jokigen_kitaueno.notes: [Sake bar · Kita-Ueno, a U-counter of charcoal grill and sake] A small sake bar on the Iriya side of Ueno with a single U-shaped counter for 16, where regulars come alone to talk with the staff. The kitchen grills Kyoto Benishigure chicken and seasonal fish over charcoal and sends out small plates — sansho-simmered liver, chicken sashimi, cartilage tsukune with perilla, beef tendon in oden style — then a monthly clay-pot rice or a golden-broth ramen to finish. More than 20 sakes, many from little-known breweries, are chosen to match; ask for sweet or dry. Reviewers in 2026 describe it as run by two women (a September 2026 diner wrote "a couple"); there is a two-drink minimum but no table charge. Book ahead; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

roles: Run by two people (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviews in February, August and September 2026 say the bar is run by two women; another September 2026 review says it is run by a couple. An April 2025 diner praised the owner's choice of sake. No source names them or gives an opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled local chicken; sake pairings; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "Perhaps because it's run by two women, the atmosphere felt calm and serene. I believe it's a place where even a woman alone can feel comfortable." — February 2026.
"I highly recommend the monthly clay pot rice; on this visit, it was onion and bacon rice." — March 2026.
"The rule of requiring at least 2 drinks per person makes it difficult to enjoy this place." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼コの字酒場 醸亀げん、北上野1-5-9、上野駅入谷口から徒歩6分、入谷駅から徒歩8分、月・木〜日・祝17:30〜23:00 (L.O.料理21:30、飲み物22:30)、火水休み、予約可 (13時から電話可、一人でも空席の確認を)、お通しなし、コの字カウンター16席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。メニュー (2026年4月): 地鶏の炭火焼き盛り合わせ (Kyoto Benishigure) 1,280円、牛すじのおでん風750円、豚の角煮のポテトサラダ720円、レバーの山椒煮600円、鶏刺し600円、鶏皮ぽん酢680円、軟骨入りつくね700円、あさりの唐揚げ680円、自家製厚揚げ680円、冷奴500円、いぶりがっこチーズ580円。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年10月): 季節の新しい料理、コの字カウンターで話しやすい、店主の日本酒の選び方、女性二人で営む、一人でも居心地がいい、月替わりの土鍋ご飯 (玉ねぎとベーコン、2026年3月)、日本酒は20種以上、1人2ドリンク制、締めのラーメン、「a couple」が営むという英語の口コミも (2026年9月)、常連が多い、Showa Street を Iriya 方面へ。

tokyo_misomebore_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free, and the miso types are not described; side dishes include kara-age (September 2026).
tokyo_misomebore_roppongi.vegan_detail: Ask. The miso soup is miso dissolved into a house dashi (August 2026) whose ingredients are not given; fillings and sides include salmon, mentaiko, meat soboro and mackerel.
tokyo_misomebore_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the day before a holiday 11:30–05:00; Sundays and holidays 11:30–18:00; closed 31 December–4 January (Tabelog). From 17:00 a one-drink minimum; ¥300 late-night charge after 23:00 (Tabelog). Miso soup and onigiri to take away without booking; a small eat-in table near the door with no cover. QR ordering (October 2026). Waits of 20–30 minutes when busy were reported (October 2026). 18 seats: 10 at the counter and 8 in booths. Heated tobacco only, in a smoking area. Cards, IC/e-money and QR. English menu and English-speaking staff. Children welcome.
tokyo_misomebore_roppongi.notes: [Miso soup · Roppongi, a miso-soup bar for every prefecture, open till 5 am] A wood-and-plants room five minutes from Roppongi Station lined with jars of miso from all 47 prefectures: pick one (a staff ranking helps), and it is stirred into the house dashi with tofu and wakame, ¥660 a bowl, next to an onigiri shaped to order. By day it is a quick lunch of soup, onigiri and obanzai; by night a sake bar with small dishes, open until 5 am. Diners in 2026 love the choice — one is collecting them all — but two wished the dashi richer, several found it pricey, and some waited long at busy times. One drink per person after 5 pm; ¥300 late-night charge after 11 pm.

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog shop text describes additive-free miso soup, seasonal obanzai and onigiri, and sake chosen by a sake sommelier. An October 2026 diner mentions a collaboration menu with the comedy trio "Hera Hera Sanjushi". No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Miso soup can be so different!" — choose your miso soup by the day's mood (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Miso soup from 47 prefectures; onigiri made to order.

anecdotes.text: "From there, I confidently chose the staff's top 3 favorite, which was "Fukuoka Miso."" — September 2026, Fukuoka miso soup ¥660.
"The miso soup is prepared by mixing the chosen miso with a pre-prepared dashi, and I felt that a richer dashi would have complemented the Edo sweet miso better." — August 2026.
"Today marks 2 out of 48. There’s still a long way to go." — October 2026, collecting the regional misos.

tokyo_sushi_yuu_tsumugi_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free; the course includes homemade ponzu, abalone with a liver sauce, an anago or eel rice bowl and a thick roll (2026 reviews).
tokyo_sushi_yuu_tsumugi_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Edomae sushi omakase.
tokyo_sushi_yuu_tsumugi_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon, Thu, Fri dinner in two seatings, 17:30–19:30 and 20:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays also lunch 12:00–14:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays, with about eight days off a month in all and occasional extra closures (Tabelog). Fully reserved time slots. No service or cover charge. Free corkage (September 2026). 14 seats: a counter of 10 and a private room for 2–4; choose counter or room when booking. Non-smoking. Cards; no e-money or QR. Families with children can use the private room.
tokyo_sushi_yuu_tsumugi_roppongi.notes: [Sushi · Roppongi, a relaxed Sushi Yuu-produced omakase] A ten-seat basement counter, plus a private room, where chef Kazuki Tahara — trained at Sushi Zai and the Michelin-starred Sushi Yuu, per the shop — serves a relaxed omakase of six small dishes, twelve nigiri and a roll for ¥16,500, or ¥19,800 with all-you-can-drink. Reviewers in 2026 single out the abalone in liver sauce stirred into sushi rice, a crab, sea urchin and caviar hand roll, and the house "pudding roll" of monkfish liver; the rice is small and lightly red-vinegared, and fish such as hata are aged a week. There is no service charge and corkage is free. Diners found the chefs friendly and the room unpretentious. Dinner runs in two seatings; weekend lunch too; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kazuki Tahara (as written in the Tabelog shop text)
roles: Chef (Tabelog shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text, chef Kazuki Tahara trained at "Sushi Zai" and the Michelin-starred "Sushi Yu". An August 2026 reviewer heard the shop is produced by Sushi Yuu, and a September 2026 regular likens the glass serving platform to the one at Ginza Sushi Yuu. The sources read do not say who owns it.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Edomae sushi in a relaxed, enjoyable setting at reasonable prices (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Abalone with liver sauce; the "pudding roll".

anecdotes.text: "The corkage fee is surprisingly free! How generous." — September 2026, third visit.
"The steamed abalone with liver sauce has a perfect balance of umami, richness, and acidity!" — October 2026.
"High-end sushi can often feel tense, but here, even at the counter seats, there was no awkward atmosphere." — August 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨結う紬、港区六本木4-5-11 ランド六本木ビルB1F、大江戸線六本木駅6番出口から徒歩3分、日比谷線4a出口から4分、月・木・金17:30〜19:30・20:00〜22:00、土日祝は12:00〜14:00も、火水休み (月8日休み、ほかにも休みあり)、完全予約制の時間帯、サービス料・チャージなし、14席 (カウンター10、個室1)、禁煙、カード可。店の紹介: 「Sushi Zai」と星付きの「Sushi Yu」で修業した Kazuki Tahara の江戸前鮨。2026年9月3日からのカウンターのおまかせ (小鉢6、握り12、巻物1) 16,500円、飲み放題付き19,800円。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 鮑の肝ソース、蟹と雲丹とキャビアの手巻き、あん肝と胡瓜と奈良漬の「プリン巻き」、赤酢の小ぶりのシャリ、1週間熟成のはた、Boston の鮪、鰻丼、持ち込み料無料、Sushi Yuu のプロデュースという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Omakase only, at set seating times.

tokyo_sushi_kappou_3_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free; the chosen dishes include fried oysters, and nigiri are served with soy sauce (2026 reviews).
tokyo_sushi_kappou_3_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi kaiseki of fish, oysters, abalone, duck and Yamagata beef.
tokyo_sushi_kappou_3_roppongi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed over New Year, Obon and Golden Week, with occasional other closures (Tabelog). Same-day bookings may be possible; contact the shop directly (Tabelog). 10% service charge. 14 seats: 8 at the counter and private rooms for 4 or 6 (room charge ¥6,000 for 3 or more). Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR. Children welcome (at the counter only if eating the same dishes as adults; infants in the private rooms). Smart casual.
tokyo_sushi_kappou_3_roppongi.notes: [Sushi · Roppongi, a pick-your-specialities sushi kaiseki from the Miyake Akira team] A modern counter of eight with private rooms behind, a few doors from its sister restaurant Miyake Akira on Enma-zaka. The "Three course" (¥15,400) pairs an omakase of 13 nigiri on red-vinegared rice with three specialities you choose by QR code — Akkeshi oysters, abalone grilled with butter, Yamagata beef sukiyaki or shabu-shabu, fugu — and the menu sets aged fish against fresh. A simpler omakase is ¥8,800, and ¥18,800 adds two hours of drinks including champagne. Diners in 2026 call it outstanding value for Roppongi and the staff friendly; one noticed the chef reduced the rice on request. 10% service; smart casual.

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog text offers "three specialties by Teru Miyake", the chef of Miyake Akira (tokyo_miyake_akira_roppongi, at Roppongi 3-8-12), and both listings carry the same invoice registration number (T7010401152275). October 2026 reviewers call it Miyake Teru's sister restaurant; one adds that Teru Miyake was made a head chef at 21 and later led "Tsutaya Kinosato Kazato" and "Tenten Temari". The chefs at this counter are not named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: High-end sushi with appetizers, comparing aged and freshly prepared fish, by Japanese chefs (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Three-speciality sushi kaiseki; aged vs fresh nigiri.

anecdotes.text: "…noticed I wanted less rice and adjusted it accordingly." — October 2026, 17-dish omakase.
"Instead of ordering the same dishes, we each picked our favorites, totaling six dishes by scanning a QR code." — October 2026, Three course ¥15,400.
"I selected the fresh oysters from Akkeshi, grilled abalone with butter, and Yamagata beef sukiyaki." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨割烹3、港区六本木3-8-7 チトセビル1F、日比谷線六本木駅から徒歩5分、大江戸線7分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (フードL.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.22:30)、年末年始・お盆・GW休み、不定休あり、サービス料10%、14席 (カウンター8、個室2: 4名と6名)、個室料6,000円 (3名以上)、禁煙、カード可、スマートカジュアル、登録番号 T7010401152275 (三宅輝と同じ)。店の紹介: 熟成と活けの食べ比べの鮨懐石、三宅輝のスペシャリテ3品を選べる。コース: おまかせ (季節の4品と握り13貫) 8,800円、スリーコース20品15,400円、飲み放題付き18,800円。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): Akkeshi の牡蠣、鮑のバター焼き、Yamagata の牛のすき焼きやしゃぶしゃぶ、蟹の茶碗蒸し、鴨とオレンジ、赤酢のシャリ、QR コードで選ぶ、三宅輝の姉妹店、シャリを少なめにしてくれた。

cultural_comfort.note: Specialities chosen by QR code; omakase at the counter.

tokyo_wagyu_sukiyaki_goku_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. The sukiyaki is simmered in a sweet-and-savoury sauce whose ingredients are not given; nothing is called gluten-free.
tokyo_wagyu_sukiyaki_goku_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu sukiyaki with raw egg; miso soup comes with the set.
tokyo_wagyu_sukiyaki_goku_roppongi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (food last order 22:15); no regular holiday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; a Sunday 19:30 walk-in got in without waiting (October 2026). 11 counter seats, each with its own IH pot; staff cook the first slice for you. Non-smoking. Cards and IC/e-money; no QR. English menu with instructions; English-speaking staff (September–October 2026). Opened 19 September 2025 (Tabelog).
tokyo_wagyu_sukiyaki_goku_roppongi.notes: [Sukiyaki · Roppongi, A5 wagyu sukiyaki for one] An eleven-seat counter by Roppongi Station and Midtown where every seat has its own induction pot: a server cooks the first slice of A5 wagyu, then you simmer the rest in a sweet-and-savoury sauce, dip it in raw egg and eat it with rice, miso soup and egg that are refilled free. Sets run from a 150 g ribeye-and-sirloin set to a four-cut premium set (strip loin, ribeye, round, chuck) or 250 g of strip loin; one diner's course with 250 g of wagyu was ¥7,800, and every meal ends with a tamago-kake-gohan perfumed with freshly shaved truffle. Open all day, 11 am to 11 pm, with an English menu that explains how to eat it; reviewers in 2026 found the staff attentive and the place popular with international guests.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 September 2025 (Tabelog). The shop says its Japanese whiskies are popular with international guests (Tabelog shop text). Reviewers name the beef as A5 Kumamoto wagyu (August 2026) and A5 Amakusa black beef (September 2026). No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: Self-cooked A5 wagyu sirloin sukiyaki in individual pots, in a casual setting (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: A5 wagyu sukiyaki; truffle TKG.

anecdotes.text: "The staff shaved fresh truffles right in front of me, releasing a delightful aroma…" — October 2026, Wagyu Premium Set.
"The English menu includes instructions on how to enjoy Sukiyaki and the truffle egg over rice, making it accessible even for those unfamiliar with Japanese cuisine." — September 2026.
"The tofu is impressively stamped with the character for "Goku," the restaurant's name." — October 2026, 250 g set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: WAGYU SUKIYAKI 極 六本木、港区六本木4-12-4 Artscape Roppongi 1F、駅近、毎日11:00〜23:00 (フードL.O.22:15)、定休日なし、11席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、2025年9月19日オープン。店の紹介: 一人鍋で自分で焼くA5和牛サーロインのすき焼き、厳選した野菜と卵、締めはトリュフの卵かけご飯、海外の客に人気のジャパニーズウイスキー。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): Kumamoto のA5和牛、Amakusa の黒毛和牛、WAGYU プレミアムセット (サーロイン、リブロース、もも、肩ロース)、150gセット、250gセット、和牛250gのコース7,800円、ご飯・味噌汁・卵はおかわり自由、最初の一枚はスタッフが焼く、「極」の焼印の豆腐、英語の食べ方の説明。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with how-to instructions and English-speaking staff (September–October 2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_ginza_soba_udon_shiraishi_roppongi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the soba is hachiwari — 80% buckwheat and 20% wheat flour (official site) — and the udon is wheat; the dipping sauces are soy-based.
tokyo_ginza_soba_udon_shiraishi_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based tsuyu and broths, with toppings such as beef tendon, duck, salmon roe and bonito flakes at the table.
tokyo_ginza_soba_udon_shiraishi_roppongi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat open 24 hours; Mon 06:00–24:00; Sundays and holidays 00:00–23:00, reopening 06:00 the next business day. The official site gives Tue–Sat 24 hours, Sun 0:00–15:00 and Mon 6:00–24:00, so Sunday closing differs; the hours here follow Tabelog and are marked irregular. No reservations. Order from photos on the wall and a touch-screen machine (October 2026). Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, though a September 2026 diner paid cashless. 20 seats: 12 at a counter, 2 tables and 5 terrace seats. Non-smoking. Menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; allergy information available (Tabelog). Halal-certified by the Japan Halal Certification Promotion Organization (JHCPO) (official site). Opened 15 February 2025 (Tabelog).
tokyo_ginza_soba_udon_shiraishi_roppongi.notes: [Soba · Roppongi, 24-hour halal-certified soba and udon] On the ground floor of the APA Hotel a minute from Roppongi Station, a 20-seat soba and udon shop with a terrace that stays open around the clock from Tuesday to Saturday. The official site says its menu is halal-certified by the Japan Halal Certification Promotion Organization (JHCPO), and its soba is hachiwari — 80% Shinshu buckwheat, 20% wheat — made under the supervision of 山根店長 of the Matsudo soba shop たぬきときつね. Order from photos and a touch screen: thick bukkake inaka soba with sweet fried tofu and egg yolk, sticky neba-neba soba, duck soba, chewy udon (long enough that scissors are provided), and rice bowls from ¥600 in a set. Reviewers in 2026 come at lunch and after a night out and find the soba firm and the sauce strong; many guests are from overseas. A second shop opened in Ginza 8-chome in 2025.

chef_bio.origin: Roppongi shop of 銀座蕎麦うどんしら石 (a second shop in Ginza 8-chome since 2025, per the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the soba is made under the full supervision of 山根店長 of 「たぬきときつね」, a well-known soba shop in Matsudo, Chiba; the menu received halal certification from the Japan Halal Certification Promotion Organization (JHCPO), which the site says examines ingredients, preparation and management against Islamic law; the operator page lists 株式会社KIRIKO, part of J.Group, whose companies include Assets name Innovation株式会社 (its domain hosts the site of 大阪つけ麺しら石, osaka_tsukemen_shiraishi_namba) and フードテクノロジー株式会社, described as the franchise-support company for a nationwide rollout of the しら石 brand. Opened 15 February 2025 (Tabelog). Included in the sweep by Greg's decision of 2026-11-02 after an earlier chain skip.
chef_bio.philosophy: Beautiful noodle strands and generous toppings, joining tradition and modern taste (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Hachiwari soba; halal-certified soba and udon, 24 hours.

anecdotes.text: "The Shinshu-produced 80% buckwheat soba has a firm texture and an excellent mouthfeel." — June 2026, regular.
"The noodles are long, so … scissors, although I didn’t use them. There were many international guests, and everyone was skillfully using chopsticks." — September 2026, mentaiko udon.
"The dipping sauce for the udon is kept hot with solid fuel… The set with negitoro rice bowl is JPY 600, and even a la carte is a bargain at JPY 800." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (soba-shiraishi.j-silver.co.jp): 銀座蕎麦うどんしら石 六本木店、本格的な蕎麦とうどんの専門店、厳選された八割蕎麦 (蕎麦粉8割、小麦粉2割)、千葉県松戸市の蕎麦の名店「たぬきときつね」山根店長の全面監修、信州産蕎麦、テラス席、2025年8月5日に銀座8丁目に2号店 (銀座店)。お品書き: しら石蕎麦、冷やしたぬき蕎麦、ねばねば蕎麦、梅おろし蕎麦、盛り蕎麦、京鴨蕎麦 (南蛮・ざる)、サーモン丼、甘エビ丼、天丼、ネギトロ丼、肉吸い、朝食セット。Japan Halal Certification Promotion Organization (JHCPO) よりメニューがハラル認証を正式に取得、ムスリムのお客様にも安心。営業: 火曜〜土曜24時間、日曜0時〜15時、月曜6時〜0時。運営会社: 株式会社KIRIKO (J.Group)。食べログ: 港区六本木6-7-8 アパホテル六本木駅前1F、六本木駅3番出口、ファミリーマートを過ぎて20秒、火〜土24時間、月6:00〜24:00、日祝0:00〜23:00、予約不可、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル2、テラス5)、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、アレルギー表示あり、2025年2月15日オープン。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 信州産の八割蕎麦、明太子うどん、とろろ昆布蕎麦、ねばねば、牛すじ釜玉うどん、カレーうどん、ぶっかけ田舎蕎麦、ネギトロ丼セット600円、うどんは長くはさみ付き、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean with photos; touch-screen ordering; many overseas guests (2026 reviews).

positives.text: Official site: the menu is halal-certified by the Japan Halal Certification Promotion Organization (JHCPO), which examines ingredients, preparation and management.

tokyo_asahikawa_shio_sugawara_ningyocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; gyoza and fried rice alongside.
tokyo_asahikawa_shio_sugawara_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-based broth with chashu ("rich depth from the meat", September 2026).
tokyo_asahikawa_shio_sugawara_ningyocho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Order at the table and pay first; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Free tororo kombu topping (August and October 2026). Seats not listed. Opened 26 November 2024 (Tabelog).
tokyo_asahikawa_shio_sugawara_ningyocho.notes: [Ramen · Ningyocho, Asahikawa shio ramen in a clear broth] The Ningyocho branch of an Asahikawa ramen shop (October 2026 reviews), open daily from 11:00 to 22:00. The draw is shio ramen in a strikingly clear broth that diners call light yet full of flavour, with a thin film of fat, thin straight noodles and tender, low-temperature-cooked chashu. There's also shoyu, a spicy miso and a gentle white miso, plus an ume-shio bowl with a whole pickled plum, and tororo kombu to add for free. Pair it with the egg fried rice. Several diners in 2026 found the staff brusque or slow to explain the pay-first ordering; one October 2026 diner thought the miso ramen and gyoza fell flat. Late-night ramen after drinks is a common use.

chef_bio.background: Per October 2026 reviews, the main branch is in Asahikawa and this is a Tokyo branch. Opened 26 November 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Clear Asahikawa-style shio ramen.

anecdotes.text: "The Shio Ramen features an astonishingly clear broth that belies its rich flavor." — October 2026.
"When the dish arrived, it featured a beautifully clear broth with a slice of pork belly chashu, topped with a pitted umeboshi (pickled plum)." — August 2026, ume-shio ramen ¥1,000.
"The broth can be chosen from four types: salt, soy sauce, miso, and white miso." — September 2026, special shoyu ramen ¥1,120.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旭川塩らーめん すがわら 人形町店、ラーメン、日本橋人形町3-3-10、毎日11:00〜22:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2024年11月26日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月、写真の見出しに「梅塩らーめん」): 本店は Asahikawa、透き通った塩スープ、軽いのに味が深い、細いストレート麺、低温調理のチャーシュー、塩・醤油・味噌・白味噌の4種、梅塩らーめん1,000円、味噌らーめん900円、特製醤油1,120円、卵チャーハン、とろろ昆布は無料、席で注文して先払い、接客がそっけないという声、味噌と餃子はいまひとつという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order verbally at the table and pay first; no ticket machine (October 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated August–October 2026.

tokyo_cado_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask. Many small plates are not wheat-based as described (oeuf mayonnaise, carpaccio, panna cotta, octopus and potato salad, omelette), but there are pastas, baguette and fried potatoes, and nothing is called gluten-free.
tokyo_cado_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Ask. A changing blackboard of small plates; a few are vegetable-led (caponata of eggplant and maitake, corn or pumpkin panna cotta), but most use egg, cheese, cream, fish or meat.
tokyo_cado_ningyocho.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun, holidays and the day before a holiday 15:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Monday (Tuesday when Monday is a holiday) (Tabelog). Book for dinner — full by 18:00 (August and October 2026); weekend afternoons can be walk-in. Table charge ¥400 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 17 seats: 7 at the counter, 10 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking. Opened 3 December 2025 (Tabelog).
tokyo_cado_ningyocho.notes: [Italian · Ningyocho, small plates and natural wine in a back alley] A lively 17-seat bistro on a Ningyocho back alley, opened in December 2025 as a sister of a Gotanda restaurant (August 2026 reviews). The blackboard of small seasonal plates is made for sharing a few among two or three. Diners in 2026 singled out the oeuf mayonnaise under almond Trapanese sauce, a corn panna cotta like set potage, grapes and pineapple with mozzarella, carpaccio with burnt-leek sauce, and scallop aglio e olio. The wine is mostly natural, poured by the glass, with staff happy to suggest what fits. It opens at 15:00 at weekends for early drinking and is usually full by 18:00 on weeknights, so book. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 December 2025 (Tabelog). Two August 2026 diners describe it as a branch of a restaurant in Gotanda, one having been to the Gotanda shop. Bookings via TableCheck (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal small plates; natural wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: "The panna cotta, while looking simple, was overwhelmingly delicious! It had the texture of a rich corn potage that was perfectly set." — August 2026.
"I was looking for a place to start drinking a bit earlier, and to my delight, they open at 3 PM on weekends, allowing me to walk in without a reservation." — August 2026.
"The staff recommended wines based on my preferences, and each one had a flavor profile I hadn't experienced much before." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: cado、イタリアン、ワインバー、日本橋人形町1-7-6 HSビル 1F、火〜金17:00〜23:00、土日祝・祝前日15:00〜23:00、月曜休み、テーブルチャージ400円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、17席 (カウンター7、テーブル10)、禁煙、2025年12月3日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): Gotanda の店の姉妹店、黒板の季節の小皿、ウフマヨ、とうもろこしのパンナコッタ、カルパッチョ、帆立とレモンのアーリオオーリオ、ぶどうとパイナップルとモッツァレラ、自然派ワインをグラスで、週末は15時から、夜は予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Blackboard menu; staff suggest wines by taste (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened December 2025; reviews dated August–October 2026.

tokyo_cado_ningyocho.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1302/A130204/13316868/ gives 35.685115, 139.782541 — 2.8 m from Himalayan Village (tokyo_himalayan_village_ningyocho, address_ja "東京都中央区日本橋人形町1-7-6 HSビル B1F") in the same building, which also holds Ningyocho Densui (tokyo_ningyocho_densui, 2F, block pin 6 m north). tokyo_onigiriya_shichiroca_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask. Plain rice, salt and nori are naturally free of wheat, and the shio musubi is just rice and salt (2023 review), but many fillings are seasoned (soy-koji bonito, sweet-soy chicken soboro, tuna mayo, simmered clams) and the miso soup blends three misos; nothing is labelled gluten-free.
tokyo_onigiriya_shichiroca_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Ask. The shio musubi and the Nanko ume onigiri are plant-based as described, but the miso soup and okaka fillings use bonito, and most fillings are fish, meat, egg or cheese.
tokyo_onigiriya_shichiroca_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 7:30–14:00, takeaway only 10:00–11:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). An October 2025 review also lists Saturday 9:00–14:00. PayPay only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Two stools for eating in; mostly takeaway (2025–26 reviews). Opened 9 September 2014 (Tabelog).
tokyo_onigiriya_shichiroca_ningyocho.notes: [Onigiri · Ningyocho, kamado-rice onigiri from a two-stool shop] A tiny onigiri shop on a Ningyocho back street, open from 7:30 on weekdays, with a showcase of about ten kinds and two stools if you want to eat there (everyone else takes away). The rice is Akita Komachi cooked in a traditional pot, shaped large, fluffy and just firm enough to hold, wrapped in Ariake nori. Fillings are generous and often house-made: salmon cured in shio-koji, tuna mayo made without canned tuna, smoky iburi-gakko with cheese, Nanko plum, simmered clams (2025–26 reviews). Add a miso soup of three misos with cabbage and komatsuna. The owner talks happily about sourcing (2025). Takeaway only from 10:00 to 11:00; closed Sundays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; talked to a May 2025 diner about the craft and sourcing)
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 September 2014 (Tabelog). Tabelog highlights fluffy rice cooked in a traditional pot, quality ingredients and homemade food. A May 2025 regular heard from the owner that fish comes from Toyosu; an October 2025 review names Akita Komachi from Ogata village, Ariake Sea nori and Tsukiji salmon in house shio-koji. Website shichiroca.net (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Quality ingredients" and "homemade" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Pot-cooked-rice onigiri; salmon in shio-koji; house tuna mayo.

anecdotes.text: "The rice is glossy and each grain stands out, crumbling perfectly when you take a bite!" — October 2025, salmon, tuna mayo and negi miso onigiri.
"The smoked gakkō cheese had a strong aroma of smoke and a rich cheese flavor, making it a unique and memorable filling for onigiri." — March 2026.
"I went right after opening, so the miso soup was a bit lukewarm, which was disappointing." — April 2026, morning set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり屋 シチロカ、日本料理、おにぎり、日本橋人形町3-5-6 榎本ビル 1F、人形町駅A5出口から徒歩2分、月〜金7:30〜14:00 (10:00〜11:00はテイクアウトのみ)、日祝休み、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、2席、禁煙、2014年9月9日オープン、釜で炊くふっくらしたご飯、「素材」と「手作り」にこだわる、ホームページ shichiroca.net。口コミ(2023年12月〜2026年6月): 大きくふっくらしたおにぎり、Ogata 村の Akita Komachi、Ariake の海苔、塩麹の鮭、ツナ缶を使わない自家製ツナマヨ、燻製たくあんとチーズ、Nanko の梅、あさりの佃煮、3種の味噌の味噌汁、土曜も9時〜14時という声、朝のセット、ほとんどは持ち帰り。

tokyo_reimei_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Chicken sashimi with salt and salt-grilled skewers may suit, but the omakase includes tapioca-flour noodles, egg-yolk soy sauce, mizutaki and finishing rice dishes such as chicken tempura rice; nothing is called gluten-free.
tokyo_reimei_ningyocho.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 18:30–23:30; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Reservations only; same-day cancellations charged 100%; service charge 10% (Tabelog). Omakase full course from 18:30 (¥13,000, September–October 2026); a short course after 21:00 bookable on Tabelog, ¥6,800 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 10 counter seats per the listing; the shop text describes a U-shaped counter of 11 (Tabelog). Second floor by lift. Non-smoking. Opened 1 April 2026 (Tabelog).
tokyo_reimei_ningyocho.notes: [Yakitori · Ningyocho, a chicken omakase counter from the founder of BLESS] Opened in April 2026 by Yohei Fujimoto, who founded the yakitori restaurant BLESS in Morishita, a Tabelog Yakitori 100 regular, and has since left it (2026 reviews). The new counter of ten or eleven seats sits on a second floor near Ningyocho station. It is less a skewer bar than a chicken kaiseki. The omakase (¥13,000) opens with chicken sashimi and a chicken "nakaochi" sushi that diners compare to negitoro, then crisp-skinned thigh, tsukune and gizzard skewers between mizutaki, tapioca noodles and inventive small dishes. It ends with your pick of duck soboro rice, chicken tempura rice or chazuke. A ¥6,800 short course starts after 21:00. Diners in September and October 2026 called it the best of their year; one found it pricey for yakitori. Reservations only; closed Sundays and Mondays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yohei Fujimoto (romaji from 2026 reviews; no kanji source found)
roles: Owner-chef (2026 reviews: founder of BLESS who opened Reimei in April 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: Yohei Fujimoto opened the yakitori diner BLESS in Morishita, Koto Ward, then sold that business (October 2026) and is no longer involved with it (September 2026), opening Reimei in Ningyocho in April 2026. Tabelog's shop text: a new challenge from a chef whose previous restaurant was a Tabelog Yakitori 100 selection five years running; experience from a Hokkaido yakitori restaurant combined with techniques learned in Tokyo; chicken, fish and vegetables direct from producers. A September 2026 diner credits the chef's Japanese-cuisine training for the mizutaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: Combine the techniques of Japanese cuisine and grilled chicken on one plate (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi and sushi; yakitori omakase with three finishing rice dishes.

anecdotes.text: "From the very first chicken nigiri, the flavor was mind-blowing. It was like a 'negitoro' (minced tuna with green onion) but without any of the usual chicken odor." — October 2026, ¥13,000 course.
"Fujimoto is said to be completely focused on Reimei, having no involvement with the current operations of BLESS." — September 2026.
"The prices are quite high for a yakitori restaurant, so it's not a place I can visit easily." — September 2026, omakase full course.

tokyo_epinard_higashiueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a fresh-pasta specialist (wheat pasta in cream, oil and Japanese-style sauces); the omurice and salads are not described as gluten-free.
tokyo_epinard_higashiueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, cheese, seafood and meat pastas, egg omurice; no vegan dish is named.
tokyo_epinard_higashiueno.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Sundays and the third Wednesday of each month (Tabelog). Reservations taken. 20 seats: 5 at the counter, 15 at tables, plus 4 on the terrace. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. Opened 11 May 2009 (a September 2025 review). Prices were raised in May 2025.
tokyo_epinard_higashiueno.notes: [Italian · Higashi-Ueno, fresh pasta from a friendly neighbourhood kitchen] A small, homey Italian restaurant between Ueno, Inaricho and Iriya, open since 2009, with a short counter at the front and tables behind. The draw is fresh pasta with a chewy bite — seafood cream, mushroom and clam, sardine and mushroom in a Japanese style, a fiery arrabbiata — and an unusual Italian-style omurice. Lunch sets with soup run about ¥1,150 (2025); at night there are salads, small dishes, wine by the glass and sake, and a February 2026 diner chatted with the friendly owner. A summer chilled pasta appears in the hot months. Closed Sundays and the third Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A February 2026 diner chatted with "the friendly owner, who seems to be a favorite" of a cousin's family. No source names the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta; omurice.

anecdotes.text: "This restaurant is known for its delicious fresh pasta, so I always order pasta when I come here." — October 2023, shrimp and mushroom cream pasta.
"Omurice (JPY 1,300). The menu lists it as JPY 1,100, but prices will be updated starting in May." — May 2025.
"I ordered the Arrabbiata, and it's spicier than usual. But the pasta is wonderfully chewy and goes down smoothly." — March 2026.

tokyo_aidayatsu_ueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles and wonton wrappers in a seafood-and-soy soup.
tokyo_aidayatsu_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bonito, mackerel and dried-sardine seafood broth, shrimp wontons and pork chashu.
tokyo_aidayatsu_ueno.hours_raw: Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesdays and Fridays (Tabelog; "no planned closures in the first half of November"). No reservations. Ticket machine outside the entrance; cash or cashless (cards, transport IC, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and more) at the machine. 20 seats: 8 at the counter and 3 tables.
tokyo_aidayatsu_ueno.notes: [Ramen · Ueno-Okachimachi, shrimp wonton noodles from the Koike group] The ramen-focused sister of the nearby tsukemen shop Aidaya, from the group behind Ramen Koike, Chuka Soba Nishino and King Seimen. The signature is shrimp wonton noodles: firm, low-hydration noodles in a strong seafood broth of bonito, mackerel and sardine, with smoky chashu and hand-wrapped wontons holding whole shrimp (¥1,330; large ¥1,430). There is also a light kombu-water tsukemen and wagyu sukiyaki rice. Diners in October 2026 mostly praised the wontons and broth; one found the fish flavour overpowering and the noodles too firm, another thought it better on an earlier visit. Buy at the machine outside (cash or cashless); open until 9 pm, closed Tuesdays and Fridays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's listing, a sister restaurant of Ramen Koike, Chuka Soba Nishino and King Seimen, offering a different style from the nearby tsukemen shop Aidaya; reviewers noticed the group's name (with Nishino) printed on the napkins (October 2026). No source names the operator, chef or opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp wonton noodles.

anecdotes.text: "The rich seafood-based double broth paired with the firm, low-hydration noodles was delicious!… The chashu (braised pork) was also surprisingly smoked." — October 2026, large shrimp wonton noodles ¥1,430.
"I ordered the kombu water tsukemen. It was a light and easy-to-eat dish, making it perfect after a night of drinking." — October 2026.
"What is this? It's really strong—are those sardines? The seafood flavor is overpowering." — October 2026.

tokyo_lupi_coffee_kitaueno.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the desserts are crepe mille-feuilles, pies and tarts, and the savoury plates include toast and a croque monsieur.
tokyo_lupi_coffee_kitaueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream-filled crepe mille-feuilles, cheesecake, condensed-milk toffee and lattes.
tokyo_lupi_coffee_kitaueno.hours_raw: Daily 8:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); may close early depending on sweets and bookings; closing days on Instagram (Tabelog). How to book: Tabelog says reservations only, by Instagram DM, first come first served until 8:00, with the day's menu posted to Instagram stories at 7:30; reviewers in July–September 2026 describe also a sign-up board at the entrance, filled from about 7:00, and an October 2026 visitor found same-day slots after work and at 9:30 announced on Instagram. One drink per person required (July 2026). 6 seats. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX) and PayPay. Takeout drip coffee. English menu. Opened 11 October 2024 (Tabelog).
tokyo_lupi_coffee_kitaueno.notes: [Café · Kita-Ueno, the six-seat crepe mille-feuille café you queue at dawn for] A tiny café a few minutes from Ueno Station whose milk-crepe mille-feuilles have a following: chewy, mochi-like crepe layers stacked with cream and seasonal fruit — figs from several varieties, peaches, Shine Muscat, cherries — cut to show a striking cross-section, alongside pies, Basque cheesecake and lattes with latte art. Prices are about ¥2,000–2,300 for a dessert plus an ¥800 drink. Getting in is the hard part: bookings open by Instagram DM at 7:30 and go in minutes, and in 2026 people signed up on the board outside from about 7 am for the first round; there are only six seats and turnover is slow. One September 2026 diner found the savoury croquette plate disappointing; most reviews rave about the sweets.

chef_bio.background: A Tabelog listing; no source names the owner. An August 2026 review says the figs come from a supplier named FIG&MORE (as written).

"The crepe itself is incredibly chewy, almost like mochi!… The cream is quite rich and sweet, so the fruits feel a bit overshadowed." — September 2026.

Tabelog says non-smoking, but a June 2026 diner found smoking allowed at the tables. Not described as halal by any source.
tokyo_aras_kebab_ameyoko.notes: [Kebab · Ameyoko, an early-opening kebab stand with benches] A busy kebab stand in Ameyoko, open from 8 or 8:30 am until late, with a few seats inside and benches on the street — a rare place to sit down in the market. Order chicken, beef or mixed doner in pita or a slim shawarma wrap, or as a salad or rice plate, at one of six spice levels (the hotter ones are properly hot); a chicken kebab with cheese was ¥700 in March 2026, and a pistachio baklava makes a sweet finish. Staff are cheerful and chatty, and reviewers in 2025–2026 call it good value; one noted the tomatoes had gone from the doner, and one found smokers at the tables. Cash only; no restroom.

"It's a smoking-friendly place, so if someone next to you is smoking, it can be quite unpleasant." — June 2026.

tokyo_kamo_nosuke_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing says the soba is pure buckwheat, and the dipping broths and the oyakodon sauce are dashi and soy based; no allergy information is given.
tokyo_kamo_nosuke_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: everything rests on a dashi broth, with duck, chicken and egg at the centre.
tokyo_kamo_nosuke_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:15–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); Sat–Sun the same hours, last dinner order 21:00; holidays lunch only; temporary closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Lunch: write your name on the waiting list outside (20–30 minutes at weekends per the shop; 30 minutes on an October 2026 holiday); oyakodon diners have a one-hour limit. Dinner is booked out nightly per the shop, so reserve; no-shows are refused future bookings, 10 minutes late counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). Evening appetizer charge ¥500 per seat (Tabelog). 16 seats: a counter of 4 and tables; hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; no kids' menu (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Suica, nanaco, iD, QUICPay); no QR (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; Chinese- and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 26 March 2022 (Tabelog).
tokyo_kamo_nosuke_yotsuya.notes: [Soba · Yotsuya, the drinkable oyakodon] A small, modern soba izakaya three minutes from Yotsuya Station whose chopstick wrappers announce "Oyakodon is a drink!": a bowl of barely set egg with a rich yolk on top, plenty of dashi and several kinds of chicken and duck, eaten plain and then with lemon, jalapeño vinegar or black shichimi as the card on the wall suggests. October 2026 diners called it the best oyakodon they had eaten; others found the ¥1,680 price high and the meat a little scarce, and one called the shop better at social media than at chicken. The duck soba, cold seiro or with a white chili-oil dip, has its own fans. Lunch means signing the list outside and waiting 20–30 minutes at weekends; dinner is a duck-and-sake izakaya, booked out most nights, with soba or oyakodon to finish. A second shop is in Asakusabashi.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 26 March 2022 (Tabelog); a second shop in Asakusabashi (Tabelog).

tokyo_sushi_sho_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Nigiri are seasoned at the counter, and the course mixes in cooked dishes (fried scallops, simmered clams, ankimo with Nara pickles) and a castella-style omelette; nothing gluten-free is mentioned.
tokyo_sushi_sho_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish and shellfish.
tokyo_sushi_sho_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon, Wed, Fri lunch 11:30–13:30 and dinner 18:00–22:30; Tue, Thu, Sat dinner 18:00–22:30; closed Sunday, Mondays that are holidays, Golden Week and New Year (Tabelog). Booking: Tabelog says reservations for the following month open on the 1st of each month; 2026 diners book TableCheck or Omakase and often take their next seat a year to eighteen months ahead before leaving. 14 seats: 11 at the counter and a 3-seat private tatami room; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners), but not at lunch (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Spend about ¥40,000–60,000 a head with drinks (2025–26 reviews).
tokyo_sushi_sho_yotsuya.notes: [Sushi · Yotsuya, the Sushi Sho head shop] The Yotsuya head shop of the Sushi Sho group, a long-time Tabelog Silver (2018–2020, 2026) and Sushi 100 pick, where the omakase weaves small dishes between nigiri, a rhythm one 2026 regular says started here. Expect around 28 servings in an hour and a half from a fast, cheerful team: grilled fish, abalone, kohada and kinmedai on red- and white-vinegar rice, then extras ordered at the end, above all the ankimo with Nara pickles and the house "ohagi". Reviewers praise the bright yuzu and sudachi seasoning and the easygoing counter. Seats go a year or more ahead, so most guests book the next visit before leaving; the following month opens on the 1st on Tabelog's note. Chef Katsumata, whose stories at the counter 2026 diners enjoyed, was leaving Yotsuya in autumn 2026, and one regular writes that a third-generation chef takes over from November, with the first generation in New York and the second at Azabudai Hills.

roles: Head shop of the Sushi Sho group ("This is the main branch of the Sushi Sho group!", September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Reviews name the counter chef as Katsumata (July–October 2026: "Chef Katsumata is as cheerful and entertaining as ever"; "I visited Sushi Sho just before Chef Katsumata left Yotsuya"). An October 2026 regular on a fourth visit: "Starting in November, the third-generation chef will take over. The first-generation chef is now in New York, and the second-generation chef is at Azabudai Hills." A September 2026 diner mentions a sister shop, Terakoya. Tabelog awards: Bronze 2017, Silver 2018–2020 and 2026; Sushi TOKYO "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Alternating otsumami and nigiri; ankimo with Nara pickles; ohagi.

anecdotes.text: "My next reservation is also a year and a half away, so far in advance that I might forget about it… I'm now enjoying it as if it were an attraction." — October 2026, ¥47,000 per person.
"An impressive 28 dishes! To be able to serve this in just over 90 minutes is a testament to the skill and teamwork of this renowned establishment." — October 2026.
"I was amazed by the presentation of two types of uni (sea urchin), reminiscent of a double scoop of ice cream." — September 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): すし匠 (Sushi Sho Yotsuya)、寿司、四谷1-11 陽臨堂ビル1F、四ツ谷駅から徒歩4分、月・水・金11:30〜13:30・18:00〜22:30、火・木・土18:00〜22:30、日曜・祝日の月曜・GW・年末年始休み、翌月の予約は毎月1日から、14席 (カウンター11、個室・座敷3)、禁煙、カード可 (ランチは不可)、子ども可、食べログアワード Bronze 2017、Silver 2018〜2020・2026、寿司 TOKYO 百名店2021・2022・2025。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年10月): つまみと握りを交互に出す、28品を90分ほどで、赤酢と白酢のシャリ、追加のあん肝と Nara 漬け、おはぎ、トロたく、2種のうに、1人4〜6万円、次の予約は1年〜1年半先、TableCheck と Omakase で予約、Katsumata の大将が四谷を離れ、11月から三代目という声。

tokyo_kusunoki_honten_yotsuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura in a wheat batter, with a tendon sauce.
tokyo_kusunoki_honten_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kuruma prawns, fish and shellfish run through every course and bowl; the egg tofu came with a dashi jelly (September 2026).
tokyo_kusunoki_honten_yotsuya.hours_raw: Reservation only. Courses: Wed–Fri from 18:00, Sat from 13:00; tempura-bowl seatings Sat 18:00–19:40; on other days 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00 depending on the day; closed Monday and Sunday; hours may vary (Tabelog). The ~¥100,000 course is hard to book: 2026 diners caught released seats on Omakase; the bara tendon seatings (35 minutes, apprentices frying) are booked through Tabelog. Changing date, time or party size incurs the cancellation fee; no extra guests including small children; no third-party booking agents; a solo party wanting all 6 seats pays for 6 courses; no strong perfume (Tabelog). 6 seats at a hinoki counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened in Yotsuya 14 June 2018 (Tabelog).
tokyo_kusunoki_honten_yotsuya.notes: [Tempura · Yotsuya, a six-seat Silver counter and its apprentices' bowl] No noren, no sign: a six-seat hinoki counter with an old ice-cooled refrigerator, where the founder, 楠, or a senior fryer cooks a ~¥100,000 course that has won a Tabelog Silver every year since 2020. The company's story starts in a kappo kitchen at 16; years in ryotei led to running a tempura counter inside one, a shop in Nagoya, then the move to Yotsuya to show the craft to the world. The site claims its tempura leaves no oil on the paper over a 2½-hour course, and that only the kuruma prawn never changes. Diners in September 2026 marvelled at the eggplant and at sea urchin fried bare in batter. The way in for most people is the bara tendon: young chefs fry a bowl of shrimp, anago, whitebait and vegetables for ¥5,500 in 35-minute seatings, light and crisp for most, a little oily for one. The course is hard to book; the tendon is booked on Tabelog.

roles: Founder, representative director and lead fryer of 株式会社くすのき (company listing; official site: "代表であり、代表職人でもある楠")
chef_bio.origin: Started in a kappo restaurant at 16, years in ryotei, then a tempura counter inside a ryotei, a shop in Kita-ku, Nagoya, and the move to Yotsuya (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: entered the trade at a kappo at 16; trained for decades in ryotei and, as sous-chef, was given the tempura counter inside one; reworked tempura from first principles of Japanese cuisine; a regional TV appearance in Nagoya (Kita-ku) filled the shop for weeks; moved to Yotsuya to take tempura to the world; sold bento during the April 2020 closure; a third fryer, 橋本祐輔, debuted after the founder and 市原; the company marked 20 years on 13 September 2023. Company listing (careermap): 代表取締役 楠忠師 (furigana クスノキタダシ), 株式会社くすのき, 四谷1-9-4 フローラ四谷1階, sister shop 天婦羅くすのき 中目黒, 12 employees (October 2025). Awards on the site: Tabelog Silver 2020–2025, Tempura 100 2023 and 2025, OAD Japan Top Restaurants 17th (2024) and 16th (2025); Tabelog also lists Silver 2026 and Tempura 100 2022. Reviewers call the founder "Master Kusunoki" and mention courses fried by "Chef Hashimoto".
chef_bio.philosophy: "しあわせの源" — to spread happiness through good food and a pleasant space; "天ぷらは世界に通じる料理" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura course; bara tendon.

anecdotes.text: "Inside the restaurant, there's an old-fashioned refrigerator that uses ice… Instead of wrapping it in seaweed, they fry the sea urchin directly in the batter." — September 2026, the course fried by the master.

"The bara-age included sweet shrimp, edamame, asparagus, whitebait, small shrimp, anago (conger eel), and eggplant… I finished everything in just over 20 minutes. Normally, this place would cost around JPY 100,000, but I got a small glimpse of it today." — September 2026, bara tendon.
"The Bara Tendon didn't quite exceed my expectations and felt a bit oily." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kusunoki-official.co.jp): しあわせの源、最大の特徴は「油ぎれ」(約2時間半のコースで敷紙に油染みがつかない)、年中出す定番ネタは車海老のみ、豊洲市場から選りすぐりの素材、食べログシルバー2020〜2025年、百名店2023・2025年、OAD 2024年17位・2025年16位、代表であり代表職人の楠は16歳で割烹料理店へ、料亭で修行を積み、副料理長として料亭の一角の天ぷら店を任される、名古屋市北区で地方番組に出演、東京四谷へ移転、2020年4月の休業中は弁当、橋本祐輔が3人目の揚げ手、2023年9月13日に創業20周年。キャリアマップ: 株式会社くすのき、代表取締役 楠忠師 (クスノキタダシ)、四谷1-9-4 フローラ四谷1階、天婦羅くすのき 中目黒、従業員12人。食べログ (店舗会員): 完全予約制、コースは水〜金18:00〜、土13:00〜、天丼は土18:00〜19:40、月曜・日曜休み、6席 (カウンター)、2018年6月14日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 弟子が揚げるばら天丼5,500円 (一品付き5,940円)、35分、ご飯200g、台湾茶、檜のカウンター、氷の冷蔵庫、うにの天ぷら。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only (Omakase for the course, Tabelog for the tendon); each dish explained at the counter (September 2026).

tokyo_il_vecchio_platano_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. The pasta is homemade fresh pasta and bread comes with the meals; dinner courses also have a main dish and salads and soups, but nothing gluten-free is mentioned.
tokyo_il_vecchio_platano_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu is handwritten; soups (e.g. pumpkin, cabbage consommé) and salads come with the sets, but no vegan dish is named and the consommé was served with prosciutto grissini.
tokyo_il_vecchio_platano_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:30; closed Sunday (Tabelog), though a November 2025 diner ate a late Sunday lunch here. Reservations taken; private room and private hire possible (Tabelog). 16 seats including a counter (Tabelog; April 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog).
tokyo_il_vecchio_platano_yotsuya.notes: [Italian · Yotsuya, fresh pasta on a quiet back street] A 16-seat second-floor trattoria on a calm street a few minutes from the station, away from the Shinmichi-dōri crowds, with a handwritten menu and homemade fresh pasta. Lunch is a pasta from four with soup or salad for ¥1,300, or a fuller set with homemade bread and dessert; at night a ¥4,400 course runs from salad and soup through pasta and a main to dessert, and one September 2026 diner was surprised with flowers for a birthday. Reviews of 2025–26 like the owner-chef's attentive service, the gnocchi with gorgonzola and the pudding; one February 2026 diner found the fresh pasta overcooked and another found the course bland, and a May 2026 diner was served something different from the handwritten sign. Closed Sundays on the listing.

roles: Owner-chef (reviews, November–December 2025)
chef_bio.background: No source names the owner-chef. "Both the owner-chef and the female staff member… left a positive impression, and the handwritten menu added a warm touch" (November 2025); "the owner provided attentive service" (November 2025); "The owner was a very nice person" (December 2025). Corporate-member Tabelog listing with no opening date given.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade fresh pasta; pudding.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the olive oil pasta with local fish from Odawara and broccoli, accompanied by a consomme soup with napa cabbage. The soup came with grissini sprinkled with prosciutto." — November 2025, ¥1,300 lunch.
"The dinner course, which includes dessert, is priced at JPY 4,400… they surprised me for my birthday with beautiful flowers and a lovely presentation!" — September 2026.
"The homemade pasta didn't quite meet expectations; it seemed overcooked and had a grainy texture." — February 2026, ¥2,200 lunch.

tokyo_kanjou_roppongi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an omakase-only course that has included tempura, fried duck in a soba crepe and duck hayashi (September 2026). The shop asks guests who cannot eat soba and duck, or who would need more than three items changed, not to book, and accepts no responsibility for allergic reactions (Tabelog).
tokyo_kanjou_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a course built around duck, with duck broth and seafood.
tokyo_kanjou_roppongi.hours_raw: Daily, two seatings: 17:00–19:30 and 20:00–22:30; doors open 10 minutes before (Tabelog). Reservation only, online through OMAKASE (Tabelog); the phone line is listed as closed. Hard to book: 2026 diners got in through cancellation notices. 10% service charge. 7 counter seats; whole-shop hire possible. Non-smoking. Cards only (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no cash, e-money or QR. English-speaking staff. No strong perfume, cologne or fabric softener: a guest whose scent affects others may be asked to leave mid-course, charged as a same-day cancellation. No sign outside: look for "roppongi 144 building" over the entrance and go to the 3rd floor. Opened 22 November 2021 (Tabelog).
tokyo_kanjou_roppongi.notes: [Duck & soba · Roppongi, award-winning duck-and-soba omakase at a 7-seat counter] Behind an unsigned door on the third floor of a building by Roppongi crossing, seven counter seats and one omakase: soba made by hand each morning, then a run of Japanese and Western dishes, then duck from some twenty suppliers grilled on a tamahagane plate forged by a swordsmith — served as several different roasts plus heart, thigh, tenderloin and tsukune — and soba again to close. Diners in 2026 were struck that the duck tasted almost like beef, praised the airy soba-yu and the duck hayashi, and found the French touches in the dishes a highlight. Tabelog Award Bronze in 2025 and 2026. Very hard to book; reservations only online, cards only, 10% service, and no strong scents.

chef_bio.chef_name: Seina Ogata (as written in the Tabelog shop text)
roles: Head chef from April 2026 (Tabelog shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: born in Kumamoto Prefecture in 1991; after culinary school, trained at restaurants including Madame Toki and Margot et Bouchère and others in Tokyo; head chef of Kanjou from April 2026. A September 2026 regular noticed the staff had all changed and felt the chef's French background in the dishes; another that month noted the head chef had changed. The interior is by Kyoto architect Tohru Kijima (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.philosophy: No flashy dishes or service — a comforting place (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Duck grilled on a tamahagane plate; handmade 100% soba.

anecdotes.text: "The duck meat didn’t taste like the duck I know; it was cooked in a way that made me think it was beef instead." — October 2026, first visit.
"I added soba water to the remaining soba broth, and while many places serve a creamy soba yu, this one was different. It was incredibly airy!" — September 2026.
"Additionally, the good rapport among the staff was evident, creating a pleasant atmosphere in the restaurant." — October 2026, with drink pairing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 感情、港区六本木4-12-5 六本木144ビル3F、六本木駅7番出口から徒歩2分、毎日17:00〜19:30と20:00〜22:30の2部制、予約のみ (OMAKASE でのネット予約)、サービス料10%、7席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カードのみ (現金不可)、英語を話すスタッフ、香水や柔軟剤など強い香りは控えるよう求める、外に看板なし、2021年11月22日オープン、The Tabelog Award 2025・2026 Bronze、日本料理 TOKYO 百名店 2023・2025。店の紹介: 毎朝手打ちする蕎麦と、約20の仕入れ先の鴨を刀匠の玉鋼の鉄板で焼く「おまかせコース」、ワインに力を入れる。料理長 Seina Ogata (1991年 Kumamoto 生まれ、Madame Toki や Margot et Bouchère などで修業、2026年4月から料理長)。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 蕎麦、和洋の料理、鴨、蕎麦、締めの流れ、牛肉と思うほどの鴨、ふわふわの蕎麦湯、鴨のハヤシ、ペアリング、キャンセル待ちで予約。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); omakase only, booked online.

tokyo_rishiri_kombu_ramen_kuroobi_roppon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles and gyoza; shoyu ramen on the menu.
tokyo_rishiri_kombu_ramen_kuroobi_roppon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the kombu broth is balanced with animal-based ingredients (October 2026), and bowls come with pork chashu and shrimp wontons.
tokyo_rishiri_kombu_ramen_kuroobi_roppon.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sat and holidays 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Sun 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); on the third Thursday of each month closed 15:00–17:00 (Tabelog). Ticket machine; some items, such as the kombu-water tsukemen, are ordered at the table and paid in cash (July 2026). 14 seats at the counter. Non-smoking. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Allergy information available. Children welcome, with kids' chairs; a May 2026 diner reports free meals for preschool children about twice a month. Takeout. Opened here 1 July 2025 (Tabelog), after the Toranomon main shop merged into the Roppongi shop (July 2025 visit).
tokyo_rishiri_kombu_ramen_kuroobi_roppon.notes: [Ramen · Roppongi, gentle Rishiri-kombu shio ramen, cash only] A bright, clean 14-seat counter near Midtown that moved here when its Toranomon main shop closed for rebuilding. The broth is built on additive-free Rishiri kombu: the signature Kuroobi Ramen (¥1,300 in shio) comes clear and gentle over thin straight noodles, with two kinds of chashu, shrimp wontons and a seasoned egg; the shoyu version is a darker amber. There is also a kombu-water tsukemen and a fiery winter special. Reviewers in 2026 drank every drop, though a couple wished the kombu came through more strongly; the hinoki chopsticks and house blend tea drew comment too. Cash only; open all day, shorter hours at weekends.

chef_bio.origin: Formerly at Toranomon (main shop) and Roppongi; merged into this shop (July 2025 visit)
chef_bio.background: Opened here 1 July 2025 (Tabelog). A diner who had visited the old shops says the Toranomon main shop was rebuilt and merged into the Roppongi location (July 2025 visit). An October 2026 reviewer says the shop is run by a food critic, not named. Another heard that the shop wanted Rishiri kombu despite its cost (October 2026). No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Additive-free Rishiri-kombu ramen.

anecdotes.text: "Instead of the usual tonkotsu, miso, or Jiro-style ramen, … maximizing the flavor of Rishiri kombu, resulting in a light yet umami-rich broth." — October 2026, shrimp wonton shio ramen.
"The soup is clear and flavorful, showcasing the umami of Rishiri kombu, with a gentle taste that is delicious." — October 2026, Kuroobi Ramen (shio) ¥1,300.
"While I could sense the refined flavor of the kombu, I felt that it lacked a bit of power, possibly due to the season." — October 2026, kombu-water tsukemen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 利尻昆布ラーメン くろおび、港区六本木4-12-5 六本木144ビル1F、六本木駅7番出口から徒歩2分、月〜金11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、土祝11:00〜21:00、日11:00〜17:00、毎月第3木曜は15:00〜17:00休み、14席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、アレルギー表示あり、子ども可、テイクアウト、2025年7月1日オープン。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): Toranomon の本店が建て替えで六本木店と統合、無添加の利尻昆布のスープ、くろおびラーメン (塩) 1,300円、バラとロースのチャーシュー、海老ワンタン、味玉、細いストレート麺、醤油の澄んだ琥珀色のスープ、昆布水つけ麺、冬限定の辛い「Kagutsuchi」、しその餃子、Ubushuna のお茶、檜の箸、未就学児は月2回ほど無料、昆布の味がもっと強ければという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine with a photo menu; some items ordered at the table, cash only.

tokyo_steam_dim_sum_wine_roppongi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a dim sum restaurant — dumplings, buns, spring rolls and dan dan noodles; dishes use oyster sauce and black bean sauce (2026 reviews).
tokyo_steam_dim_sum_wine_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan dishes are described; the dim sum and small steamed plates are pork, chicken and seafood.
tokyo_steam_dim_sum_wine_roppongi.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–21:00, two-hour limit; lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00, courses only, booked by 21:00 the day before (walk-ins if seats are free) (Tabelog). May close early if there are no bookings, so call ahead (Tabelog). Bookings recommended — full on several 2026 visits. ¥880 table charge. 20 seats with a counter; private hire for up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. School-age children welcome, no preschoolers; steep stairs, no strollers. Sommelier on staff.
tokyo_steam_dim_sum_wine_roppongi.notes: [Dim sum · Roppongi, seasonal dim sum with wine in a basement by Midtown] Down a steep stair just outside Midtown, a 20-seat room where Cantonese-style dim sum is given seasonal Japanese twists — seafood dumplings with sweet potato and black sesame, chicken shumai rolled in five-grain rice — and paired with wines, many natural, chosen by the sommelier. A regular since 2020 calls it a favourite dim sum place in Tokyo, ordering the steamed spare ribs twice; others single out the yellow shumai, spring rolls and a tangy dan dan noodle to finish. A few 2026 diners found some dishes average. Dinner nightly with a ¥880 table charge; weekend lunch is set courses from ¥4,900. Book ahead.

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog shop text describes dim sum by skilled dim sum chefs, using Chinese, Japanese and Western techniques, and wines selected by a sommelier. A reviewer who has visited since 2020 notes that the floor manager is an excellent sommelier (December 2024 visit). No one is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal dim sum, carefully wrapped, to be eaten hot; wines chosen to support the dim sum (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Steamed spare ribs; seasonal dim sum with wine.

anecdotes.text: "Aside from dim sum, the Spicy Chicken, Steamed Spare Ribs, and Steamed Grouper in Broth are absolutely exquisite!" — August 2026, eighth visit.
"These dim sums go beyond the usual dim sum offerings, allowing you to enjoy combinations of seasonal ingredients and unexpected flavors." — October 2026, à la carte.
"They were the perfect size for a finale, with a strong tangy flavor and thin noodles that matched my taste perfectly." — June 2026, dan dan noodles.

tokyo_tori_sawa_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers come salted or with tare, and grated daikon is served with soy sauce (October 2026); the closing dishes include chilled tantanmen and ramen. Nothing is called gluten-free.
tokyo_tori_sawa_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori omakase, finishing with chicken soup or soboro rice.
tokyo_tori_sawa_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, two seatings: 17:30–20:00 (please arrive by about 18:00) and 20:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Omakase with a stop system — skewers keep coming until you say stop, and the bill depends on how much you eat (Tabelog); one diner found service cut off at closing time (September 2026). 11 counter seats; private hire for up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. Only guests of middle-school age or older who can eat as much as an adult. Black door with no obvious sign (October 2026). Opened 26 September 2022 (Tabelog). Raw liver is offered at the start at your own risk (October 2026).
tokyo_tori_sawa_roppongi.notes: [Yakitori · Roppongi, a Tabelog-100 yakitori omakase behind a black door] An all-black counter of eleven behind an unmarked black door on Roppongi-dori, where Daisen chicken is grilled over Kishu binchotan and handed over skewer by skewer until you say stop. Diners in 2026 praised the range of cuts — aorta, sori, chōchin with its bursting yolk, a nearly raw breast with wasabi — and the creamy raw liver offered at your own risk at the start, then soboro rice or chilled tantanmen to finish. The omakase is listed at ¥12,000; wine and sake are fairly priced for Roppongi, though one diner thought the cost performance poor and the stop system cut short at closing. Selected for the Tabelog yakitori 100 (East) in 2025. Two seatings, Monday to Saturday.

The Tabelog shop text describes Kishu binchotan, Daisen chicken and a chef's-choice stop system. Opened 26 September 2022 (Tabelog).

tokyo_ota_zushi_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask. Nigiri is served with soy sauce, and the ikura gunkan is topped with soy sauce and the scallop with a sweet sauce (2026 reviews); nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_ota_zushi_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish sushi counter.
tokyo_ota_zushi_ningyocho.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Fri from 11:00 to about 13:00, served in rounds of nine; dinner Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), by reservation only; closed Sat, Sun and holidays (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Lunch is first come, first served — a queue forms before 11:00, with waiting in the tatami area behind the counter and then outside (July–October 2026). Lunch is cash only (August 2026); Tabelog lists JCB, AMEX and Diners cards. 9 counter seats; no private rooms; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). No chopsticks — nigiri is eaten by hand, one oshibori each (2026 reviews). Non-smoking. Established 1955, in a 1927 building that survived the air raids; second generation; staffed by the owner, the owner's son and the owner's sister (July 2026 review).
tokyo_ota_zushi_ningyocho.notes: [Sushi · Ningyocho, giant nigiri at a 1955 counter] A nine-seat sushi counter in a 1927 building that survived the war's air raids, founded in 1955 and run by the second generation, with the owner's son now behind the counter too (July 2026). Lunch, Tuesday to Friday, is the famous part. The chef first asks what size of rice you want, on a five-step scale from Ginza-small to a piece the size of a rice ball. There are no chopsticks; you eat by hand. The tuna hides a second layer of tuna beneath. A serving is ¥4,600; 1.5 servings, with more pieces, is ¥6,900. Queues start before 11:00, and the second round waits about 40–45 minutes. Regulars (one reviewer has been 34 times) mix with Instagram-led first-timers and visitors from abroad. Some found the biggest sizes hard to eat. Dinner by reservation; lunch cash only.

tokyo_firmamento_ningyocho.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A set omakase that includes handmade pasta, panelle, suppli and focaccia (2026 reviews); nothing is described as gluten-free.
tokyo_firmamento_ningyocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish- and meat-led omakase (squid, sea urchin, eel, soft-shell turtle, suckling pig).
tokyo_firmamento_ningyocho.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 19:00–23:00; closed Sunday; closing days irregular (Tabelog). One omakase course, about ¥25,000 (May 2026, up from about ¥22,000), plus 10% service (Tabelog); wine or non-alcoholic pairing. Reservations (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats at an L-shaped counter (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking. Opened 4 September 2025 (Tabelog; May 2026 review; an August 2026 review says "opened last spring").
tokyo_firmamento_ningyocho.notes: [Italian · Ningyocho, an eight-seat Italian counter cooking Japanese ingredients] Opened in September 2025 on the third floor of a new dining building on Suehiro-dori, an L-shaped counter where owner-chef Yuya Daisako cooks a single omakase. The chef trained at ICARO, GUCCI Osteria Tokyo and the Japanese restaurant Ryugin (August 2026). The name means "sky", and the shop's idea is Italian dishes stripped down to show Japanese seasonal produce. In 2026 that meant aged Tokushima squid as panelle, abalone suppli over a liver sauce, an eel risotto lifted with yuzu and sudachi, and pappardelle with soft-shell turtle and matsutake. Sommelier Katsuya Kuwahara's pairings win as much praise as the food. Opinions vary between visits: a June 2026 returning diner found 8 of 15 dishes repeated, a September diner noticed an odour in the suckling pig, and an August diner called it the best Italian meal of a lifetime. About ¥25,000 plus service.

tokyo_jugemu_tantanmen_horidome.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; fried paiko and shumai alongside.
tokyo_jugemu_tantanmen_horidome.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tantanmen with domestic pork (October 2026), chashu and toppings of chicken or pork.
tokyo_jugemu_tantanmen_horidome.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–16:00 and 17:30–23:00; Sat and holidays 11:00–16:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 5 tables for two (Tabelog). Smoking allowed per Tabelog. Rice free with any order (2026 reviews). Opened 3 October 2017 (Tabelog).
tokyo_jugemu_tantanmen_horidome.notes: [Ramen · Horidome-cho, sesame-rich tantanmen with free rice] A small tantanmen shop on a residential street a couple of minutes from Ningyocho station, full of office workers at weekday lunch. The broth is built on house-roasted sesame and spice oil, creamy rather than thick, with thin straight noodles (one September 2026 diner found them medium-thick), and you choose the heat and firmness. Most order the paiko tantanmen with a crisp fried pork chop (¥1,250), or the dry version with thick noodles and Sichuan pepper; rice is free to finish the soup. Reviewers compare it, favourably, with the Hashigo tantanmen and its shumai; a July 2026 diner had heard it is from the Hashigo lineage, which no source confirms. Cash only; smoking allowed per Tabelog; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 October 2017 (Tabelog). Reviewers in September–October 2026 compare it with Hashigo — "the Tantan-men from the 'Hashigo' lineage", "a good alternative to Hashigo" — and one wondered whether it belonged to the Hashigo group; no source confirms a link. The origin of tantanmen is written on the wall (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Paiko tantanmen; dry tantanmen.

anecdotes.text: "The rich flavor of the house-roasted sesame is prominent, and the texture is incredibly creamy." — September 2026, paiko tantanmen ¥1,250.
"This place is a good alternative to Hashigo." — October 2026.
"The broth was not thick but rather light and smooth, which is why the noodles are thin." — October 2026, paiko tantanmen.

tokyo_iekei_akaya_ningyocho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Ticket machine (August 2026); cards and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). A free large serving of noodles and free rice (April–August 2026; a June 2026 review says one or the other); grated garlic and chopped onion free on the table (2026 reviews). Opened February 2025 on the former site of Niku no Marukiyo (August 2026 review). Seats not listed.
tokyo_iekei_akaya_ningyocho.notes: [Ramen · Ningyocho, Yokohama iekei ramen until 23:00] A red-fronted iekei ramen shop east of Ningyocho station, one of the few of its kind nearby (June 2026), open daily until 23:00. It serves a tonkotsu-shoyu bowl with medium-thick noodles, spinach and nori, set up the iekei way — choose noodle firmness, richness and oil. A large serving of noodles or a bowl of rice is free, and grated garlic and chopped onion sit on the counter. Diners in 2026 called it reliable and good value (¥900 with rice), milder than some iekei, with a tantan tsukemen one August diner especially liked. Others found the broth lacking depth, and one August 2026 bowl arrived cold.

chef_bio.background: Opened in February 2025 on the former site of Niku no Marukiyo (August 2026 review). An August 2026 diner was served by two staff, both from abroad.
chef_bio.specialty: Iekei ramen with free rice.
